title: HR Recruiter
description:
**About Blackstone Group Technologies Pvt Ltd**

Blackstone Group Technologies Pvt Ltd (BGT) is a globally recognized technology and engineering services company with over **30 years of experience** in structural steel detailing, BIM solutions, advanced robotic fabrication, and engineering consultancy. Headquartered in **Chicago, Illinois**, BGT operates a state\-of\-the\-art **30,000 sq. ft. ODC in India**, serving clients across Commercial, Institutional, Healthcare, Industrial, and Mining sectors in the US and Canada.

Driven by precision, quality, and innovation, BGT has built strong, long\-standing partnerships with leading global organizations. At BGT, **people are our greatest asset** — and we continuously invest in nurturing the next generation of talent to sustain our legacy of excellence.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a passionate and detail\-oriented **HR Recruiter (Fresher)** to join our HR team at Blackstone Group Technologies Pvt Ltd. This is a great opportunity for **2025 \& 2026 batch graduates** to gain hands\-on exposure to the complete recruitment lifecycle — from sourcing and screening candidates to scheduling interviews, stakeholder follow\-ups, and facilitating smooth hiring. You will also participate in conducting initial interview rounds, building practical experience in candidate evaluation and hiring decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Talent Sourcing \& Candidate Management**

● Source and attract candidates through various platforms including job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Shine), social media, employee referrals, and campus recruitment drives.

● Create and post compelling and accurate job advertisements in alignment with role requirements and company culture.

● Build and maintain a robust talent pipeline for current and future hiring needs across various departments.

● Screen resumes and application forms to shortlist candidates who match the required qualifications and experience profile.

**Interview Scheduling \& Coordination**

● Schedule and coordinate interviews between shortlisted candidates and the respective hiring managers or department heads.

● Manage interview logistics — sending calendar invites, sharing interview formats, and ensuring all stakeholders are well\-prepared.

● Coordinate panel availability and ensure timely scheduling without conflicts or delays.

● Maintain organized records of interview schedules, outcomes, and feedback in the ATS (Applicant Tracking System) or HR systems.

**Candidate Follow\-Up \& Communication**

● Proactively follow up with candidates at every stage of the recruitment process to keep them informed and engaged.

● Send timely communication including interview confirmations, feedback notifications, offer letters, and onboarding instructions.

● Build positive candidate relationships and maintain a professional, empathetic, and responsive communication approach.

● Track candidate drop\-offs, understand reasons, and provide feedback to improve the candidate experience.

**Interview Participation \& Evaluation**

● Actively participate in conducting initial screening rounds and HR interviews for shortlisted candidates.

● Evaluate candidates on communication skills, attitude, cultural fit, and overall suitability for the role.

● Share structured feedback and hiring recommendations with senior HR team members after each interview.

● Develop and refine interview questionnaires and competency\-based assessment tools over time.

**End\-to\-End Recruitment Support**

● Manage the complete recruitment workflow — from job requisition receipt to offer rollout and pre\-onboarding formalities.

● Coordinate with department heads to understand exact hiring requirements, timelines, and job specifications.

● Maintain and update daily/weekly recruitment trackers and MIS reports for management review.

● Assist in organizing walk\-in drives, job fairs, and campus placement events as required.

● Support the onboarding process by coordinating documentation, induction scheduling, and day\-one readiness for new joiners.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

**Educational Qualification**

● MBA/MSW (Human Resources) from a recognized university or institution.

● Candidates who have completed their degree in the year 2025 or 2026 are eligible to apply.

● Candidates awaiting results of their final semester/year are also encouraged to apply (subject to qualification confirmation).

**Skills \& Competencies**

● Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; knowledge of regional languages is an added advantage.

● Good interpersonal skills with the ability to engage professionally with candidates, hiring managers, and team members.

● Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office tools — Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

● Familiarity with job portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, or Shine is preferred.

● Ability to multitask, prioritize workloads, and work effectively under deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.

● High attention to detail with strong organizational and follow\-up skills.

● Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within the HR function.

**What You Will Gain at BGT**

This role is designed to give fresh HR graduates a comprehensive, real\-world understanding of the recruitment function in a professionally managed, globally connected organization. As part of the BGT HR team, you will:

● Gain end\-to\-end exposure to the entire recruitment lifecycle in an international work environment.

● Develop hands\-on skills in talent sourcing, candidate engagement, interview facilitation, and offer management.

● Learn to work with structured HR processes, tools, and reporting systems.

● Receive mentorship from experienced HR professionals and leadership teams.

● Build confidence in conducting interviews and assessing talent across varied roles and seniority levels.

● Be part of a reputed, 30\+ year old engineering and technology organization with a strong global presence.

Pay: ₹21,500\.00 per month

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

coordination skills.

Qualification

Bachelor’s degree / MBA / diploma in any of the following preferred:

* Supply Chain Management
* Logistics Management
* Operations Management
* Business Administration
* Commerce
* Industrial Engineering or related field

* Excellent English communication \- written and spoken
* Strong email drafting skills
* Good coordination and follow\-up ability
* Willingness to work from the warehouse
* Good understanding of MS Excel / Google Sheets
* Ability to learn WMS/software systems
* Strong observation and reporting skills
* High ownership and accountability
* Ability to work with warehouse staff, supervisors, transport teams, and management
* Willingness to learn warehouse operations from the ground level

Important Note

This is a warehouse\-based operations role, not a desk\-only office role.

The candidate must be comfortable working from the warehouse floor, monitoring live operations, coordinating with

multiple teams, and ensuring that activities are completed properly.

The candidate will not be required to do manual loading, unloading, or pick\-and\-pack work, but must be actively

involved in supervising, checking, coordinating, and reporting warehouse activities.

Preferred Personality

* Confident communicator
* Smart and quick learner
* Professional in email and verbal communication
* Not hesitant to work in a warehouse environment
* Detail\-oriented
* Disciplined and punctual
* Able to handle pressure
* Able to speak to clients and internal teams professionally
* Interested in building a long\-term career in supply chain and logistics

Salary range: Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 35,000 take\-home per month, depending on communication skills, educational

Exceptional candidates may be considered more at the time of discussion.

description:
**Recruitment Executive – Overseas Recruitment**

Job Summary

The Recruitment Executive is responsible for sourcing, screening, interviewing, and coordinating candidates for overseas employment opportunities. The role involves managing the end\-to\-end recruitment process, maintaining client relationships, negotiating with candidates, and ensuring timely fulfillment of manpower requirements for international clients.

Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Source candidates through job portals, social media, databases, referrals, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on client requirements.
* Conduct telephonic, virtual, and face\-to\-face interviews.
* Assess candidates’ qualifications, experience, skills, and suitability for overseas assignments.
* Maintain an updated candidate database and talent pipeline.

Client Requirement Management

* Understand client manpower requirements and job specifications.
* Coordinate with overseas clients regarding vacancies, recruitment status, and candidate profiles.
* Ensure timely submission of suitable candidate CVs to clients.
* Meet recruitment targets and project deadlines.

Candidate Coordination

* Communicate job opportunities, salary packages, benefits, and employment terms clearly to candidates.
* Coordinate interviews, trade tests, and client selection processes.
* Guide candidates through documentation, visa, medical, and deployment procedures.
* Maintain regular follow\-up with candidates throughout the recruitment cycle.

Negotiation \& Relationship Management

* Negotiate salary expectations and employment terms between candidates and clients.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with candidates and clients.
* Handle candidate concerns and resolve recruitment\-related issues professionally.

Documentation \& Compliance

* Verify candidate documents, qualifications, and employment history.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and overseas recruitment regulations.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records and reports.
* Prepare recruitment reports and status updates for management.

Required Qualifications

* **Bachelor’s Degree** in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or any related field.
* Additional certification in Recruitment, HR, or Talent Acquisition is an advantage.

Experience

* **2–3 years of experience in Overseas Recruitment / International Manpower Recruitment.**
* Experience recruiting for GCC countries, construction, oil \& gas, healthcare, hospitality, retail, IT, or engineering sectors is preferred.
* Experience handling bulk hiring and international client requirements is an added advantage.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong negotiation and persuasion skills.
* Ability to conduct competency\-based interviews and candidate assessments.
* Strong sourcing and networking capabilities.
* Knowledge of recruitment portals, social media recruitment, and applicant tracking systems (ATS).
* Good interpersonal and relationship management skills.
* Strong organizational and time\-management abilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet recruitment targets.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint).

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of positions successfully closed.
* Time\-to\-fill vacancies.
* Client satisfaction levels.
* Candidate retention and deployment success rate.
* Recruitment target achievement.
* Quality and accuracy of candidate submissions.
* Database growth and candidate engagement.

Working Conditions

* Full\-time office\-based role.
* Occasional travel for recruitment drives, job fairs, and client meetings.
* Flexible working hours during urgent recruitment projects.

Salary Range

* As per company policy, qualifications, and experience.

Career Progression

Recruitment Executive → Senior Recruitment Executive → Recruitment Team Leader → Recruitment Manager → Operations Manager

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Age: 22–35 years.
* Professional, target\-oriented, and self\-motivated.
* Strong customer service mindset.
* Ability to build long\-term relationships with clients and candidates.
* Experience in handling multicultural candidates and international recruitment processes.

title: Branch Manager
description:
Designation:


Location: India Uttar Pradesh Mohalla Ram Nagar Sharanpur


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\) Key Result Areas:** Writethe key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\- **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports:** Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.
**6\) Relationships:** Describe the nature and purpose of most important contacts or relationship (except superior/team members) with individuals, departments, organizations inside and outside of the organization, that job is required to interact with to deliver the job objectives

title: Cybersecurity Triage Analyst
description:
About Cetark Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  

At Cetark Solutions, we are committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity with innovative solutions and cutting\-edge services. Our culture promotes openness, collaboration, and continuous learning. We value fresh perspectives and encourage individuals to take ownership of their growth and contributions.
The Cyber Security Triage Analyst will play vital role in the 24x7 Threat Detection Operations Centre helping to detect, protect, and respond to cyber security events. The Triage Analyst will be responsible for reviewing security events of interest, enriching those events, and responding to those events or escalating those events to the Cyber Security Incident Response Team. 7\. Stay current on IT security trends and news.

**The Role:** **Talent Acquisition Manager** will support Talent Acquisition’s (TA) mission to connect the British Council with great talent, matching skills to opportunities to enable the organisation to deliver its mission. We will do this by leveraging the British Council brand to attract and select talent that aligns with our values, and by delivering an equitable and inclusive candidate and employee experience.
  

Taking responsibility for delivering an exceptional end\-to\-end recruitment service (with a focus on specialist/managerial positions), the role will support the transition of Recruitment from its current transactional service to a strategic Talent Acquisition service, delivering global recruitment performance improvement. In addition, the role will support the drive to increase the appeal of the British Council as an employer of choice to individuals from underrepresented backgrounds.
  

  

**Accountabilities:**  

Deliver quality hires for the British Council ensuring all roles have an agreed talent acquisition (TA) plan which is delivered to a high standard (delivery focus is on specialist /strategic roles).

title: Security Engineer (Web3 and Web2)
description:
Role \& Responsibilities
   

  

 We are seeking a Security Engineer I to join our team. The ideal candidate will be
   

  

 responsible for both Web3 and Web2 security paradigms, knowledge of Amazon Web
   

  

 Services (AWS), and proficiency in monitoring and alerting systems. This role involves
   

  

 ensuring the security of our digital assets, infrastructure, and applications.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Perform penetration testing of applications/products based on Web, Mobile, Web3 assets like Smart Contract, Bitcoin Script, etc.
* Plan and perform red team exercises in a variety of environments.
* Manage applications/products bug bounty program with validation and response mechanism for vulnerabilities submitted by external researchers.
* Continuous research on new attack vectors/techniques and their mitigations.
* Manage attack surface based on risk assessment for the business.
* Develop scripts, tools and methodologies to enhance security posture of the whole company and its applications/products.
* Manage continuous passive and active monitoring and alert systems such as Prometheus, Grafana, Wazuh, etc.
* Apply knowledge of AWS services to support the maintenance of secure cloud infrastructure. Deployment and management of security tools (open source and commercial)
* Clear communication for vulnerability reports and their remediation required.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to align and priorities remediation efforts.
* Work collaboratively/independently on unique or special assignments which may require specialized knowledge and/or experience.
* Comply with company, division and professional ethical standards.


 Ideal Candidate
   

  

* Strong Security Engineer Profile — Web3 \& Web2 \| Penetration Testing, Cloud Security \& Blockchain
* Mandatory (Experience) — Must have 4\+year of experience in a security engineering role or related position — covering both Web3 and Web2 security paradigms across application, infrastructure, and cloud security contexts.
* Mandatory (Penetration Testing \& Red Teaming) — Must have hands\-on experience performing penetration testing on Web, Mobile, and Web3 assets — including Smart Contracts and Bitcoin Scripts — and must have planned or executed red team exercises across varied environments.
* Mandatory (Application Security Knowledge) — Must have strong working knowledge of OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25, NIST, MITRE ATT\&CK, and shift\-left security methodologies — with the ability to apply these in vulnerability identification and risk prioritisation.
* Mandatory (Infrastructure \& Networking Architecture) — Must have a strong understanding of application, infrastructure, and networking architecture — with the ability to assess attack surfaces holistically and manage risk across business assets.
* Mandatory (Monitoring \& Alerting) — Must be proficient in deploying and managing continuous monitoring and alerting systems — with direct exposure to tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Wazuh, or comparable security tooling.
* Mandatory (AWS \& Cloud Security) — Must have working familiarity with AWS services and basic cloud security concepts — with practical ability to support and maintain secure cloud infrastructure.
* Mandatory (Scripting \& Tooling) — Must be able to develop scripts, tools, and methodologies to enhance security posture — with working knowledge of at least one of Go, Rust, TypeScript, or Python.
* Mandatory (Blockchain Security Fundamentals) — Must have a foundational understanding of blockchain technologies and associated security considerations — covering smart contract security, Bitcoin script analysis, or related Web3 attack vectors.
* Mandatory (Education) — Must hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Mandatory (Company)\- Candidate must have prior experience working at a blockchain or Web3\-native product company.
* Preferred (Experience Depth) — More than 2 years in a security engineering role is a plus — reflecting deeper ownership of security programmes and broader exposure to advanced attack techniques.
* Preferred (Bug Bounty Program Management) — Experience managing a bug bounty program end\-to\-end — including vulnerability validation, researcher response coordination, and clear written communication of findings and remediation — is a meaningful plus.
* Preferred (Certifications) — Holding any one of C\-PENT, eJPT, PWPP, or GPEN is a plus as validated evidence of offensive security competency.
* Role Structure — Note: This is an Individual Contributor (IC) role initially — with the expectation of building and leading a security team as the function matures.


 Skills: infrastructure,cloud,web2,security,web3,cloud security,penetration testing,blockchain,aws

* **Business Development:** Lead efforts to generate new business by identifying potential customers, forming partnerships, and promoting company’s financial products.

**The Team:**


In this role, you will be a key member of the Global Total Rewards team, providing year‑round support for broad‑based compensation programs, processes, and initiatives in partnership with colleagues across regions.


You will work closely with Compensation Leads and Total Rewards colleagues, with growing exposure to HR partners and business stakeholders as experience develops. Based in India, this role supports a global compensation model and is well suited for someone looking to build a strong technical compensation foundation, starting with execution and progressing toward more independent analysis and advisory support. The role reports to the Compensation Lead.


**Responsibilities and Impact:**


* Partner with the Total Rewards team to deliver broad\-based compensation support for the business, assisting senior team members with defined deliverables and timelines.

Synchrony is more than a financial services company, we’re a team of passionate innovators committed to delivering best\-in\-class solutions that support millions of customers across the U.S. With a bold focus on technology, data, and digital innovation, we create meaningful experiences that simplify lives and enable financial wellness.

**Job Description**
-------------------


Job ID
2601541
Category
Technology

05/23/2026  

  

**Role Title: AVP, Information Security Program Manager (L10\)**


**Company Overview:**

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.


* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles

**Organizational Overview:**

The Information Security organization partners across Technology and the business to protect Synchrony’s customers, data, and platforms. The India InfoSec program function drives security culture, awareness, and engagement across sites, aligning local initiatives with enterprise security priorities and ensuring strong participation, measurable outcomes, and consistent execution.


**Role Summary/Purpose:**

As AVP, Information Security Program Manager, you will lead the strategy, planning, and execution of India\-focused InfoSec engagement programs that strengthen security culture and community. This includes security hackathons/CTFs, university/student engagement, employee\-facing campaigns, and India hub/site\-level InfoSec initiatives. You will partner with Enterprise InfoSec leaders, India site leadership, universities, suppliers, and cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver high\-impact programs using Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.


**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Own the India InfoSec engagement roadmap and annual calendar; translate priorities into plans and measurable outcomes.
* Deliver year\-round security culture programs (communications, learning, contests, speaker sessions).
* Lead InfoSec hackathons/CTFs end\-to\-end: themes/objectives, problem statements (with SMEs/suppliers/universities), platform setup, participant onboarding, logistics, judging, recognition, and reporting/playbooks.
* Manage event budgets/forecasts, vendor coordination, and resource planning (as applicable).
* Ensure initiatives align with enterprise security policies, brand/communications standards, and legal/compliance requirements.
* Run a structured university engagement program (campus connects, guest lectures, workshops, mentorship, CTFs) and maintain key university partnerships.

Job Summary\-

Vishram Management Group (VMG) is seeking a highly sophisticated, purely independent, and execution\-focused Senior HR Manager. This is not a traditional HR role; it is a full\-ownership mandate for an HR architect who can build, scale, and discipline a high\-performance organization from scratch.

Operating across multiple diverse business verticals—including Study Abroad, Work Abroad, (VIS) as well as Retail, QSR (Quick Service Restaurants), and Backend Operations (VMG)—you will design the infrastructure that governs our talent lifecycle. You will be fully empowered to operate autonomously, implementing systems, driving accountability, and optimizing human capital ROI without requiring day\-to\-day supervision.

Responsibilities

1\. Absolute HR Ownership \& Governance

* Take end\-to\-end strategic and operational accountability for the entire HR lifecycle across both entities (VIS \& VMG).
* Autonomously manage talent acquisition, onboarding, employee relations, payroll compliance, performance evaluations, and structured offboarding.
* Serve as the ultimate point of escalation for internal conflicts, disciplinary actions, and labor compliance.

2\. Strategic Talent Acquisition \& Team Architecture

* Partner with business unit heads to accurately forecast talent requirements based on business needs and clear ROI metrics, avoiding headcount inflation.
* Design, implement, and scale aggressive sourcing and hiring strategies tailored for both high\-volume roles (Sales, QSR, Retail) and highly specialized corporate roles.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Description**


**Who is USP?**


The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.


At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.


USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.


**Brief Job Overview**


Talent Acquisition Specialist is a key mission enabler at USP and we’re seeking an exceptional recruiter to join our team. Our new team member will lead their hiring managers through the full lifecycle of recruiting for a variety of professional, technical, scientific, and administrative positions. Primary responsibilities involve deep partnership and with business leaders and hiring managers to effectively source, recruit, evaluate, interview, and select top Acquisition/HR projects that will strengthen USP offerings and branding as an employer of choice.


**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**


As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.


Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.


The TA Specialist has the following responsibilities:


* Conducts full lifecycle recruiting for assigned searches beginning with a strategy meeting with the hiring manager to discuss process and strategic sourcing approach
* Creates an effective sourcing strategy based on business needs and identify candidates through standard and creative methods
* Evaluates the resumes/profiles of prospective candidates and determines degree of skill match; recommends or declines appropriately and forwards qualified short\-listed candidate resumes to the hiring manager for review.
* Tracks candidate activity from initial resume submittal to hire in the applicant tracking system (ATS);
* Coordinates receiving and evaluating of interview feedback and advises hiring manager in the final selection process.
* Collaborates with the HRBP, Compensation \& Benefits and others as needed in establishing salaries.
* Checks references, verifies educational credentials, and coordinates background investigation of selected candidate; negotiates and makes verbal and written offers of employment.
* Works with colleagues to prepare weekly reports to monitor recruitment activity, tracks vacant positions, recruiting strategies/sources, and costs.
* Analyze market trends and competitor practices to continuously refine talent attraction and branding strategies.

Additional roles and responsibilities include:


* Work on visually appealing and informative quarterly Dashboards and to be presented to the Leadership.
* Share Weekly Recruitment reports with the Leadership
* Work on Contract agreements and payments with various vendors as and when required
* .
* Ensure that all Job Portals and third\-party verification contracts are up to date and be the single point of contact for recruitment needs
* Ensure Talent acquisition is always Audit Compliant.
* . Identifies processes and practices for continuous improvement and champions appropriate changes as needed.

**Who is USP Looking For?**


The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:


* Master's Degree/Post Graduate Diploma (Full\-Time) in Human Resource Management from a business school is preferred, with 8 years of professional recruiting experience to include leadership and strategic project experience.
* Demonstrated full\-lifecycle recruitment experience working in corporate or agency environments.
* Experience in cold calling, candidate development and directly sourcing candidates from a variety of media including standard sourcing tools (social networks, corporate websites, general job boards, professional associations, agencies, college postings and alumni organizations, open houses) to build candidate pipelines
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office is required, as is familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS)

**Additional Desired Preferences**


* Recruitment experience within Pharmaceuticals and/or health care life sciences, biotechnology industry.
* Experience in behavioral and/or competency\-based interviewing techniques
* Advanced ability to understand complex requirements and effectively communicate with hiring managers and candidates
* Strong partnership and relationship building skills with the ability to adjust to multiple changing, and often competing, priorities
* Ability to help build a pipeline of diverse candidate to help company achieve DEIB goals
* Excellent time management, communication, and project management skills
* Superior verbal and written communication skills
* Must be able to work independently as well as in a team environment
* Strong technology orientation and skills related to social networking, sourcing techniques.
* Experience working with HRIS systems, UltiPro/UKG is a plus

**Supervisory Responsibilities**


None, this is an individual contributor role.


**Benefits**


USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.


Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

description:
**Summary**
 At Apple, people don’t just build products—they create innovations that transform industries. Driven by diverse ideas, we deliver advanced technology and environmental leadership. Join us and help leave the world better than we found it.
   

  

 Working at Apple means being challenged, inspired, and proud of what you create. Here, great ideas quickly become exceptional products, services, and customer experiences.
   

  

 The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team powers platforms like the App Store, Apple TV, Apple Music, Apple Podcasts, and Apple Books, delivering content at scale across 150\+ countries.
   

  

 ASE engineers build secure, end\-to\-end systems, including software, tools, server infrastructure, and APIs that support Apple services.
   

  

 The ADP Processing SRE team supports analytics and data services, focusing on reliability, automation, and continuous improvement to ensure strong user experiences.
   

  

 Apple’s integration of hardware, software, and services enables teams to work toward a unified vision with a deep commitment to privacy. Teams remain small and cross\-functional, offering meaningful opportunities to learn and contribute.
   

  

**Description**
 The Service Reliability Engineer (SRE) role in Apple Services Engineering requires a mix of strategic engineering and design along with hands\-on, technical work. This SRE will configure, tune, and fix multi\-tiered systems to achieve optimal application performance, stability and availability.
   

  

 We manage jobs as well as applications on bare\-metal and cloud computing platforms to deliver data processing for many of Apple’s global products. Our teams work with exabytes of data, petabytes of memory, and tens of thousands of jobs to enable predicable and performant data analytics enabling features in Apple Music, TV\+, Appstore and other world class products.
   

  

 If you love designing, running systems that will impact millions of users, then this is the place for you!
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support Java\-based applications \& Spark/Flink jobs on Baremetal, AWS \& Kubernetes
* Ability to understand the application requirements (Performance, Security, Scalability, etc.) and assess the right services/topology on AWS, Baremetal \& Kubernetes
* Build automation to enable self\-healing systems
* Build tools to monitor high performance \& alert the low\-latency applications
* Ability to troubleshoot application\-specific, core network, system \& performance issues.
* Involvement in challenging and fast\-paced projects supporting Apple's business by delivering innovative solutions.
* Monitor production, staging, test and development environments for a myriad of applications in an agile and dynamic organisation.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 0\-18 months of experience in a Site Reliability Engineering role.
* Understanding of SRE principles and goals.
* Good programming skills in any high level languages like Python, Go, Java.
* Familiarity with Linux environments (process management, file systems, troubleshooting) and networking fundamentals (HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, TCP/IP).
* Ability to analyze issues, identify root causes, and propose solutions.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to complete tasks with attention especially during incidents.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* Exposure to cloud platforms like Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure.
* Basic understanding or academic/project exposure to big data technologies such as Apache Hadoop, Apache Spark, or Apache Flink.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Exposure to collaborative development (e.g., team projects, internships, or open\-source contributions), including working with distributed teams.
* Familiarity with production support processes, incident management, and system reliability.
* Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows.
* Familiarity with containerization tools like Docker and to orchestration systems such as Kubernetes.
* Awareness of monitoring and observability tools like Prometheus and Grafana.

title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
description:
About ARCHLE Labs

ARCHLE Labs – Advanced Research Centre for Health and Life Science Engineering is a health\-tech R\&D startup based in Bangalore. We are building science and engineering\-driven healthcare solutions that improve access, affordability, and quality of care.

Our vision is simple:

To make quality healthcare accessible to everyone.

India needs healthcare solutions that are practical, scalable, and accessible across diverse communities. This requires professionals who can support systems, coordinate teams, manage operations, and help bring innovation to the people who need it most.

At ARCHLE Labs, your work will not be limited to routine office tasks. You will be part of a mission\-driven team working to build products, systems, and operations that support the future of public health.

About the Role

We are looking for a Sales Executive who will be responsible for selling hospital software solutions and medical devices to hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, diagnostic centres, and healthcare institutions.

The role involves identifying potential customers, visiting hospitals and clinics, understanding their requirements, presenting ARCHLE Labs’ healthcare solutions, conducting product demonstrations, following up with prospects, and closing sales.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable with field sales, customer communication, product explanation, lead generation, and meeting healthcare decision\-makers such as doctors, clinic owners, hospital administrators, purchase managers, and biomedical teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and generate leads from hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, diagnostic centres, and healthcare providers.
* Visit hospitals and clinics to present hospital software solutions and medical devices.
* Meet doctors, clinic owners, hospital administrators, biomedical engineers, purchase managers, and other key decision\-makers.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable healthcare software or device solutions.
* Conduct product demos and explain features, benefits, pricing, and use cases clearly.
* Follow up with leads and convert prospects into customers.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with hospitals, clinics, and healthcare professionals.
* Coordinate with internal teams for product demos, quotations, proposals, installation, training, and after\-sales support.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, customer visits, follow\-ups, sales pipeline, and closures.
* Track customer interactions using CRM tools, Excel, Google Sheets, or internal sales systems.
* Collect market feedback, competitor information, and customer requirements.
* Support payment follow\-ups and customer onboarding when required.

Required Skills

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to sell to hospitals, clinics, doctors, and healthcare institutions.
* Good presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Confidence to conduct field visits and meet senior decision\-makers.
* Basic understanding of healthcare, hospital workflows, medical devices, or software products.
* Ability to explain technical products in a simple and convincing manner.
* Self\-motivated, disciplined, target\-oriented, and willing to travel.
* Basic knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets, CRM tools, or sales tracking systems.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Science, Pharmacy, Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare Management, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, healthcare sales, hospital software sales, medical device sales, pharma sales, or institutional sales preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and willingness to work in field sales may also apply.
* Prior experience selling to hospitals, clinics, doctors, or healthcare institutions will be an added advantage.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in HMIS sales or hospital management software sales.
* Experience selling healthcare software to hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, or diagnostic centres.
* Understanding of hospital workflows such as registration, appointment management, billing, pharmacy, lab, EMR/EHR, patient records, and reporting.
* Medical device or diagnostic equipment sales experience will be an added advantage.
* Existing network with hospitals, clinics, doctors, administrators, or purchase departments.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work in a fast\-growing health\-tech R\&D startup.
* Exposure to healthcare software, medical devices, and public health innovation.
* Performance\-based incentives and growth opportunities.
* ESOPs for eligible team members based on role, performance, and long\-term contribution.
* Product training and sales support.
* Career growth in healthcare technology, HMIS, and medical device sales.
* Mission\-driven work environment focused on improving healthcare access.

description:
**Job Title :** Academic Counsellor / Overseas Education Counsellor

**Company :** Medcity International Overseas Corporation

**Industry :** Study Abroad

**Job Location :** Kannur

**Job Type :** Full Time, On\-site

**Benefits :** Attractive Incentives (Spot Incentives)

The Overseas Education Counsellor holds a significant responsibility towards the study abroad business as this role is entitled to provide accurate information about professional courses abroad, best destinations, admission options available in top\-ranking universities and colleges, nearest possible intakes, visa and documentation process and lot more. The counsellor’s timely guidance, counselling assistance and clear communication with the client matters a lot.

**Key areas of responsibility**

**Student Counselling**

Provide personalized counseling to students based on their academic background, career goals, budget, and preferred destinations.

Advise students on suitable study destinations, universities, and courses that align with their interests and qualifications.

Assist students with inquiries, providing in\-depth knowledge and suggestions based on their needs.

Engage with students in a positive, approachable, and respectful manner.

**Targets \& Registrations**

Achieve or exceed daily, weekly, monthly and yearly targets by using effective counselling techniques and strategies

Inform clients to attend attractive webinars, expos, events, and study abroad virtual sessions to enhance chances of registrations

Having the best knowledge of all study abroad destinations, programs, eligibility requirements, culture, rules and regulations of various countries, etc. can help in achieving goals easily.

**Calls \& Follow\-ups**

Achieving 50 connected calls on a daily basis can bring in better results in terms of your work productivity

Follow\-ups on a timely basis for all enquiries and for all registered clients can make the results better and relationships longer .

**Lead Generation**

As a counselor with experience and knowledge, contribute with your creativity, ideas and talents to attract and generate potential leads

Involve in activities such as content preparation for course promotions, webinars, script writing for videos and reels, planning and coordination for in\-house expos and events, initiate programs and presentations with schools / colleges

**Record Keeping \& Report**

Prepare daily, weekly, monthly reports and update the sheet every evening before 5 Pm.

Lead Sheet, Registration status, Client documents etc. need to be shared with the respective point of contacts within the TAT

Keep a record of information, client data, course details, fee structure, website information (bookmarks), etc for timely references

**Research \& Update Knowledge**

As a student counselor (Academic resource person), it is important to stay updated with the latest trends and challenges, intakes opened/closed, new services and offers,etc.

Learn about the study abroad industry, competitors, market, business updates and strategies that fit better towards your goals

**Participation \& Support**

Participate in all major events hosted or initiated by the respective branch. This can be related to a Webinar, In\-house Expo, Seminar, Delegate Meeting, Training Session, Discussions etc.

**Team / Branch Meetings**

Daily, Weekly, and Monthly meetings will be happening at regular intervals. Always be prepared to discuss the status of the work, plans, and initiatives. Morning and Evening briefing sessions with the respective BM will be held daily.

**Walk\-in’s / Virtual Counselling**

Counsellor must be able to generate 10\-20 successful walk\-in’s every month followed by virtual counselling for those clients who are far and unable to directly reach the office.

**Branch Visits / Lead Calls**

Counsellor should be able to visit the allocated branches (Academy) for receiving leads and to directly meet students. Lead follow\-ups and calls must be regularly done to build a strong relationship with the respective branches, CRO and students

**Qualifications / Requirements**

A bachelor’s degree in education, international relations, business, or a related field.

Experience in counseling or student services, especially in the context of international education.

preference for freshers with excellent Language proficiency

**Skills \& Competencies**

*Strong Communication Skills*

*Organizational Skills*

*Knowledge of International Education*

*Customer Service*

*Problem Solving*

*Attention to Detail*

*Multitasking*

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

Must be available to work flexible hours, including weekends if required based on business needs.

Must have a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to learn

Highly passionate and self\-motivated to guide students with responsibility

Go\-getter attitude with patience and professionalism at the workplace

Clean track record of previous employment with certificates \& letters.

Result\-driven and revenue\-generation expert

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**About the Company:**
 Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically\-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross\-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners.
   

  

 Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations.
   

  

 Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be responsible for the architecture, deployment, and optimization of our global, high\-availability network infrastructure across data centers and AWS cloud environments. Your role involves expert\-level knowledge in managing complex enterprise routing and switching, designing and maintaining enterprise Wireless Infrastructure (Cisco Meraki), configuring enterprise\-grade firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto), and integrating hybrid cloud solutions. You will bridge the gap between high\-level business goals and technical execution, ensuring our network is cost\-optimized, secure by design, and resilient.
   

  

**Required Skills:**
* Bachelor’s Degree and 7\+ years of experience in Network Engineering
* Expert\-level knowledge in designing and maintaining scalable, high\-availability network solutions across global data centers and AWS cloud environments.
* Proven ability to manage communication and coordination with external vendors and partners for timely resolution of network service issues.
* Proficiency in managing complex enterprise routing and switching
* Proven experience in designing, deploying, and optimizing enterprise Wireless Technologies.
* Hands on experience on handing Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE)
* In\-depth knowledge of AWS Networking components, including VPCs, Transit Gateways, Direct Connect, and Client VPNs, for hybrid cloud integration.
* Hands\-on experience configuring and maintaining enterprise\-grade firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet etc.).
* Familiarity with data center technologies such as VXLAN, EVPN, or Cisco ACI.
* Strong competency in proactive network health monitoring, troubleshooting complex Layer 2 and Layer 3 issues, and leading Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* Ability to manage physical hardware lifecycle (racking, stacking, and cabling) and oversee server room environmental monitoring, power distribution (PDU), and UPS systems.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Network Architecture: Design and maintain scalable, high\-availability network solutions across global data centers and AWS cloud environments.
* Routing \& Switching: Manage complex enterprise environments utilizing BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP.
* Wireless Infrastructure: Design, deploy, and optimize enterprise Wi\-Fi using Cisco Meraki, ensuring seamless roaming, high density, and secure guest/corporate access.
* Hybrid Cloud Integration: Design and manage AWS Networking components, including VPCs, Transit Gateways, Direct Connect, and Client VPNs.
* Security \& Firewalls: Configure and maintain enterprise\-grade firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet, or Cisco Firepower) to protect critical assets.
* Data Center \& Server Room Management:
+ Manage physical hardware lifecycle (racking, stacking, and cabling).
+ Oversee server room environmental monitoring, power distribution (PDU), and UPS systems.
+ Maintain data center technologies such as VXLAN, EVPN, or Cisco ACI.

* Performance Monitoring: Proactively monitor network health, troubleshoot complex Layer 2 and Layer 3 issues, and lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) efforts.
* Cisco Identity Services Engine


**Mandatory Certifications (Anyone)**
* SISE \- Implementing and Configuring Cisco Identity Services Engine
* DCACI \- Implementing Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure
* PCNSE \- Network Security Administrator


**Preferred Certifications**
* CCNP/CCIE \- Cisco Certified Network Professional or Similar
* AWS Certified Advanced Networking \- Specialty

**Trainer – Tailoring (Woven \& Knits)**

Department

Training / Production

Reporting To

Training Manager / Unit HR Manager / Production Manager

Location

Garment Factory / Training Centre

Job Purpose

To train fresher candidates and existing employees in garment stitching operations for both woven and knitted garments, ensuring improvement in sewing skills, quality standards, productivity, discipline, and line readiness as per factory requirements.

Key ResponsibilitiesTraining \& Skill Development

* Provide practical and theoretical training to fresher tailors and helper trainees.
* Train operators in handling sewing machines for woven and knitted garment production.
* Conduct training on various sewing operations such as:
* Single needle
* Overlock
* Flatlock
* Feed\-off\-arm
* Buttonhole
* Bartack
* Kansai and other special machines
* Teach garment construction methods for shirts, pants, t\-shirts, leggings, innerwear, and other products.
* Explain sewing techniques, seam quality, measurement accuracy, and finishing standards.
* Conduct skill upgradation training for existing tailors to improve efficiency and multi\-skilling.

Production \& Quality Support

* Support production departments by supplying trained operators to sewing lines.
* Monitor trainee performance on productivity and quality parameters.
* Reduce alteration and rejection percentage through proper training.
* Train employees on SOPs, operation bulletins, safety procedures, and quality standards.
* Coordinate with QA and Production teams for training requirements.

Machine Handling \& Maintenance

* Train employees on safe handling of sewing machines and attachments.
* Guide trainees on basic machine maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Coordinate with mechanics for machine readiness during training sessions.

Assessment \& Documentation

* Conduct skill assessments and operator evaluations periodically.
* Maintain trainee attendance, skill matrix, and training records.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly training reports.
* Identify slow learners and provide additional coaching.

Behavioral \& Workplace Training

* Educate trainees on factory discipline, attendance, housekeeping, and safety practices.
* Motivate trainees for retention and continuous improvement.
* Ensure proper workplace behavior and teamwork among trainees.

Eligibility CriteriaEducational Qualification

* ITI / Diploma in Garment Technology / Fashion Technology preferred.
* Minimum SSLC/HSC with strong garment industry experience can also be considered.

Experience

* 5 to 10 years experience in garment sewing operations.
* Minimum 2 to 3 years experience as Tailoring Trainer / Line Trainer preferred.
* Strong knowledge in both woven and knitted garment manufacturing.

Required Skills

* Excellent tailoring and sewing knowledge.
* Strong practical training capability.
* Knowledge of industrial sewing machines.
* Good communication and demonstration skills.
* Ability to handle fresher candidates effectively.
* Knowledge of garment quality standards and productivity improvement.
* Basic reporting and documentation skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

* Number of trainees converted into operators.
* Training completion percentage.
* Productivity achievement of trained operators.
* Reduction in rejection and alteration percentage.
* Retention of trained employees.
* Multi\-skill development achievement.

Working Conditions

* Factory and training centre environment.
* Standing and practical demonstration work involved.
* May support production during peak requirements.

Additional Preference

* Candidates with experience in rural tailoring training, apprenticeship programs, or government skill development projects will be preferred.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

title: Senior MERN Stack Developer
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **MERN Stack Developer** with strong hands\-on expertise in MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently developing, maintaining, and optimizing full\-stack web applications.

This role requires someone who has solid knowledge across the entire MERN stack, with a

stronger preference for candidates who are highly skilled in backend development, API

architecture, database design, and application performance.

Experience with Next.js and basic deployment/server handling will be considered an added

advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Full Stack Development**

● Develop scalable and maintainable web applications using MongoDB, Express.js,React.js, and Node.js.

● Build complete end\-to\-end features from frontend UI to backend APIs and database integration.

● Write clean, reusable, modular, and well\-structured code.

● Understand business requirements and convert them into technical solutions.

● Take ownership of assigned modules and deliver them independently.

**Backend Development**

● Design and develop robust backend APIs using Node.js and Express.js.

● Implement business logic, middleware, validations, authentication, and authorization.

● Create secure and optimized REST APIs with proper request/response structures.

● Handle error management, logging, API performance, and backend scalability.

● Work with JWT, role\-based access control, file uploads, third\-party APIs, and webhooks.

● Maintain clean backend architecture using controllers, services, routes, models, and utilities.

**Database Management**

● Design and maintain MongoDB schemas and data models.

● Work with relationships, aggregations, indexing, and query optimization.

● Ensure data consistency, performance, and proper database structure.

● Debug and optimize slow queries and database\-related issues.

**Frontend Development**

● Build responsive and user\-friendly interfaces using React.js.

● Create reusable components, hooks, layouts, and frontend utilities.

● Integrate APIs with proper loading states, error handling, validations, and edge\-case handling.

● Manage frontend state using Redux, Zustand, Context API, or other project\-required tools.

● Optimize frontend performance by reducing unnecessary re\-renders and improving UI flow.

**API Integration \& Authentication**

● Integrate frontend screens with backend APIs using proper data mapping.

● Implement login, registration, token handling, protected routes, and session

management.

● Handle API errors, empty states, validation messages, and permission\-based flows.

**Performance \& Code Quality**

● Optimize application performance on both frontend and backend.

● Improve API response time, database queries, frontend rendering, and bundle size.

● Follow coding standards, best practices, and proper Git workflow.

● Review, debug, refactor, and improve existing code when required.

**Third\-Party Integrations**

● Integrate payment gateways, email/SMS services, cloud storage, analytics tools, and

external APIs.

● Handle webhook flows, sandbox/production configurations, and secure API key

management.

**Deployment \& Environment Handling**

● Prepare frontend and backend builds for development, staging, and production

environments.

● Manage environment variables and configuration files securely.

● Basic understanding of deployment on VPS/cloud platforms will be an added advantage.

● Validate deployments with functional testing and issue resolution.

**Technical Leadership \& Team Guidance**

● Guide junior and mid\-level developers in technical implementation, code structure, and

best practices.

● Review code and provide constructive feedback to maintain code quality.

● Help developers resolve technical blockers and debugging issues.

● Suggest better approaches for architecture, API design, database structure, and

frontend implementation.

● Ensure the team follows proper coding standards, Git workflow, and project structure.

● Support the Team Lead/Project Manager in technical planning, estimation, and feasibility

analysis.

● Share knowledge with the team and help improve overall development practices.

● Take ownership of complex modules and support other developers in delivering their

assigned tasks.

**Next.js Knowledge \- Added Advantage**

● Experience with Next.js will be preferred.

● Understanding of SSR, SSG, routing, API routes, middleware, and performance

optimization in Next.js will be a plus.

**Required Skills**

● Strong hands\-on experience with MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js.

● Good command over backend development using Node.js and Express.js.

● Strong understanding of REST API development and integration.

● Experience with MongoDB schema design, aggregation, indexing, and optimization.

● Good knowledge of React.js components, hooks, state management, and UI integration.

● Experience with authentication, authorization, JWT, middleware, and protected routes.

● Ability to write clean, scalable, and maintainable code.

● Good debugging and problem\-solving skills.

● Experience with Git and standard development workflows.

● Ability to work independently on assigned modules.

**Preferred / Added Advantage Skills**

● Experience with Next.js.

● Basic deployment knowledge on VPS, cloud servers, or platforms like Hostinger, AWS,

DigitalOcean, Vercel, or similar.

● Knowledge of Redis, caching, queues, or background jobs.

● Experience with payment gateways, webhooks, and third\-party integrations.

● Familiarity with Docker or CI/CD basics.

● Understanding of application security and performance optimization.

**Experience Level**

● Looking for a mid\-level to senior\-level MERN Stack Developer.

● Candidate should not be a fresher.

● Candidate must have practical project experience and should be able to handle full\-stack

development independently.

● Strong backend experience will be highly preferred.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate should be someone who:

● Has strong practical experience in the complete MERN stack.

● Can independently handle frontend, backend, database, and API integration.

● Is stronger on backend development but comfortable working across the full stack.

● Can understand requirements, suggest technical solutions, and take ownership.

● Writes clean, structured, and scalable code.

● Has problem\-solving ability beyond basic implementation.

● Has additional exposure to Next.js and deployment workflows.

 Real problems. Real teams. Real impact. Fast.

title: Documentation Analyst - Trainee
company: Godspeed Immigration & Study Abroad Pvt Ltd
description:
**Position: Documentation Analyst Trainee**

**Industry: Immigration \& Study Abroad**

**Company: Godspeed Immigration \& Study Abroad Pvt Ltd**

***Job Summary:***

The Documentation Analyst Trainee is responsible for assisting the documentation and processing team in preparing, verifying, and organizing client documents related to immigration, PR, work permit, visitor visa, and study abroad applications. The role requires attention to detail, confidentiality, and proper coordination with clients and internal teams.

***Key Responsibilities:***

1\. Documentation Support

* Collect and organize client documents for visa and immigration processes
* Verify documents as per the immigration checklist and requirements
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of submitted documents
* Maintain digital and physical client records properly

2\. Client Coordination

* Communicate with clients regarding pending documents and updates
* Assist clients in understanding documentation requirements
* Follow up with clients for timely submission of documents

3\. File Preparation \& Processing

* Prepare client files for processing and submission
* Support the processing team with application documentation
* Update file status and maintain proper records in CRM/software

4\. Quality Checking

* Cross\-check information and documents before submission
* Identify missing or incorrect information in client files
* Ensure compliance with company SOPs and immigration guidelines

5\. Data Management

* Maintain confidentiality of client and company information
* Update client databases and documentation trackers regularly
* Prepare reports as instructed by management

6\. Learning \& Training

* Attend training sessions related to immigration documentation and processes
* Learn country\-specific documentation requirements and procedures
* Support senior documentation analysts in day\-to\-day activities

***Required Skills:***

* Good communication skills
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Office, Email, CRM)
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Time management and organizational skills
* Ability to work in a team environment
* Willingness to learn immigration procedures

***Qualification***:

* Any Degree / Diploma
* Freshers can apply

***Preferred Skills:***

* Experience in documentation or customer support is an added advantage
* Basic knowledge of immigration or overseas education processes preferred

Pay: ₹15,500\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement

Work Location: In person

title: Manager- HR
description:
Griffith Foods is the caring, creative product development partner helping food companies meet the evolving needs of consumers while sustaining the planet. As a family business founded in 1919 and headquartered in Alsip, Illinois USA, Griffith Foods is known for true, collaborative innovation guided by their Purpose of “We Blend Care and Creativity to Nourish the World”. The company’s product capabilities range from seasonings and marinades to coating systems and sauces that are better for people and better for the planet. For more information, visit www.griffithfoods.com.
   

  

**Industrial Relations \& Legal Compliance**
* Liaise with labor department, factory inspectorate, PF/ESI authorities, and other statutory bodies.
* Ensure adherence to applicable labor laws including the Factories Act, CLRA, EPF Act, Minimum Wages Act, etc.
* Conduct monthly labor management meetings and maintain all statutory records and registers.
* Prepare legal documentation, notices, responses, and support inspections or audits.
* Identify emerging IR risks and implement preventive measures during plant scale\-up or operational changes.


**Contractor Workforce Governance**
* Ensure full compliance of contract labor management as per CLRA and statutory norms.
* Monitor contractor adherence to PF, ESI, wages, working hours, and documentation standards.
* Drive recruitment, attendance control, and efficient deployment of contract workforce.
* Conduct audits of contractors/vendors to ensure governance and legal compliance.
* Manage manpower documentation for ongoing operations and expansion projects.


**Plant Statutory \& Safety Compliance**
* Oversee statutory requirements related to boiler, metrology, safety, environment, and PCB regulations.
* Ensure timely inspections, certifications, approvals, renewals, and statutory filings.
* Maintain all compliance statutory registers, licenses, renewals, and filings and documentation for audits, inspections, and regulatory visits and handle inspections, notices, and compliance audits.
* Coordinate welfare and safety activities in partnership with the plant safety team
* Welfare \& Safety: Oversee canteen, safety, and employee welfare activities in coordination with the safety team.
* Oversee statutory compliance for new plant expansion or equipment installation.


**Disciplinary \& Legal Matters**
* Draft and manage all legal documents, notices, and responses related to labor or statutory authorities.
* Handle grievances, misconduct cases, and disciplinary procedures legally.
* Conduct domestic enquiries and disciplinary actions with strict adherence to labor laws.
* Maintain documentation for legal defense in inspections or disputes.
* Completing initial reporting, accident investigations, communication work restrictions, claim adjuster correspondence, tracking and claim review analysis for settlement
* Draft charge sheets, warning letters, suspension and termination documentation.
* Represent the company in conciliation or labor proceedings if required.


**Risk Management \& Advisory**
* Advise management on statutory risks and gaps in compliance.
* Implement preventive measures to avoid legal violations or penalties.
* Keep management updated on changes in labor laws, environmental regulations, and plant statutory requirements.
* Ensure compliance during plant expansion, new shifts, or additional manpower deployment.
* Monitor overtime, working hours, wage structures, and safety compliance.
* Advise management on IR risks during rapid operational growth.


**HR Operations**
* Manage end\-to\-end HR operations at the plant, ensuring alignment with production priorities.
* Drive manpower planning and workforce budgeting in line with production forecasts.
* Oversee end\-to\-end recruitment and onboarding for plant workforce (permanent and contractual).
* Manage employee lifecycle processes including confirmation, transfers, promotions, and separations.
* Drive performance management implementation for plant employees.
* Responsible for payroll inputs, attendance systems, shift management, and statutory deductions.
* Lead employee engagement initiatives and foster positive shop\-floor culture.
* Implement training and development programs focused on skill enhancement and compliance.
* Ensure effective employee communication, engagement, and grievance handling.
* Support succession planning and capability building for critical plant roles.
* Collaborate with production, maintenance, quality, and safety teams to ensure smooth operations.
* Maintain plant HR dashboards (attrition, absenteeism, productivity, compliance status).
