**About Flight Ops**
--------------------

  

Airbound operates a fleet of next‑generation delivery aircraft, and the Operations team ensures every flight runs seamlessly and cost\-effectively. As an early‑stage aerial‑logistics company, we view Operations as a strategic pillar that drives growth and innovation.


The team wears many hats: overseeing launch‑site selection and setup, flight planning, fleet utilization, and client onboarding. We also monitor weather, collate flight data, and aggregate historical patterns to power predictive analytics, while establishing the SOPs that keep our network running safely. Beyond routine workflows, we work on big\-ticket problems such as cost‑optimization and pricing strategy.


Operations is the glue that holds Airbound together. We work cross\-functionally with engineering teams to translate growth ambitions into a detailed operations roadmap, which directly informs product design and engineering priorities.


We have a strong bias for execution that is heavily informed by data. Decisions are guided by metrics—not gut instinct. We form hypotheses through critical thinking, then validate (or disprove) them with rigorous analysis of flight logs, delivery times, and cost metrics.


We’re process\-obsessed, relentlessly data‑driven, and biased toward rapid, efficient execution—always asking\- How can we deliver better, faster, and cheaper?

  

**Where the UAV PILOT\- FLIGHT OPERATIONS comes into the picture**
------------------------------------------------------------------

  

At Airbound, the UAV Pilot\- Flight Operations plays a critical role in executing and scaling drone delivery missions. As part of the core flight operations team, this individual will directly operate our indigenous hybrid VTOL UAVs, ensuring safe, compliant, and reliable transport of critical payloads across our logistics networks.

  

**And these are all the exciting things our UAV PILOT\- FLIGHT OPERATIONS gets to work on**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Operate Airbound’s indigenous fleet of hybrid VTOL UAVs as per SOPs in day\-to\-day delivery missions and test flights
* Conduct detailed pre\-flight, in\-flight, and post\-flight checks
* Execute missions in compliance with DGCA regulations, Airbound’s internal flight safety protocols, and site\-specific restrictions
* Coordinate with ground teams, external partners, and ATC authorities where applicable
* Maintain accurate flight logs, incident reports, and aircraft maintenance schedules
* Monitor weather, assist in flight planning
* Perform basic field troubleshooting of UAVs and GCS (ground control stations)
* Assist in training and mentoring new drone pilots as the program scales
* Contribute to continuous improvement of flight SOPs and operational workflows
* Support aircraft integration and customer demos as needed

* Freshers with a genuine passion for aviation and the ambition to become certified UAV / Drone Pilots.

**Performance Tuning:** Identify database bottlenecks, analyze execution plans, optimize slow\-running queries, and implement indexing strategies to minimize latency.


**Backend Integration:** Collaborate with core backend engineers to integrate relational database logic with system\-level modules and multi\-language SDKs.


**Debugging \& Maintenance:** Analyze database logs, error reports, and application behaviors to diagnose and resolve data\-flow anomalies.


**Documentation:** Create and maintain documentation for database designs, schema architecture, and pseudocode logic for complex procedures.

**Databases:** Solid understanding of relational database management systems (RDBMS), specifically **Oracle** or **PostgreSQL**.


**Database Programming:** Deep, hands\-on knowledge of writing and troubleshooting **Stored Procedures**, triggers, functions, and relational queries.


**Data Foundations:** Strong understanding of relational data modeling, normalization, indexing, and transactional concepts (ACID properties).


**Problem Solving:** Excellent logical thinking and ability to draft pseudocode to plan out complex data manipulation logic.


#### **2\. Preferred Add\-on Skills (Highly Desirable):**


**Languages:** Foundational knowledge or academic exposure to **C and C\+\+** (specifically understanding how application code interacts with databases).


**Object\-Oriented Concepts:** Understanding of basic OOPs principles to align with backend infrastructure.


**Data Formats:** Familiarity with handling and parsing structured data formats like **XML** and **JSON** within the database.


Exposure to basic server environments (Windows/Linux) and basic software development life cycles (SDLC).


#### **3\. Soft Skills \& Analytical Abilities:**


Sharp analytical mindset with a focus on data accuracy and validation.


Strong verbal and written communication skills to document workflows clearly.


A proactive approach to learning new database technologies and optimization tools.

**Title: Instrumentation Sales for Sensors and Applications.** 

**Location: Mumbai.** 

Our customers span automotive, packaging, food and beverage, chemicals, pharma, compressed air, water and utilities, and Industry 4\.0 digitalisation.

**THE ROLE**

A consultative, field\-heavy position.

You walk factory floors across Mumbai, Pune, and Nashik, read the machines, run discovery conversations with maintenance and plant teams, map sensor and IIoT opportunities, and convert technical conversations into quotations and orders.

You sell outcomes (reduced downtime, lower energy cost, real\-time visibility), not part numbers.

Position sensors (inductive, photoelectric, capacitive, ultrasonic), process sensors (pressure, flow, level, temperature, conductivity), condition monitoring (vibration, oil quality, octavis), IO\-Link masters and gateways, IIoT platform, safety technology, and connection technology.

**Industries**: factory automation (automotive, FMCG, packaging, OEMs), process and utilities (F\&B, chemicals, pharma, compressed air, water), mobile machines, and Industry 4\.0 digitalisation.

**Technical foundations:** measurement principles, signal types (PNP/NPN, 4–20 mA), PLC and fieldbus basics, process variables and units, P\&ID reading, hazardous\-area classification, IP ratings, sensor failure modes, and calibration.

title: Production Technician
description:
**About Airbound**
------------------

**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**


This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.


The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground\-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.


To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

*Candidates will be selected to support either the Composites or Assembly track. Candidates will have the option to choose their preference while filling out the application form.*

**Common across both tracks:**
------------------------------

* **Precision Work** — Do detailed, careful work where alignment and finish matter. Millimetre\-level accuracy, clean cable layout, correct tightness, no shortcuts
* **Quality Focus** — Check your own work at every step, point out problems early, follow checklists carefully, and keep proper build records
* **Spotting Defects** — Inspect parts for issues relevant to your track — misalignment, loose fasteners, bad crimps (Assembly) or air pockets, layer separation, dry spots, and resin\-starved areas (Composites); raise issues early and help find the root cause
* **Tools \& Workstation Care** — Keep your bench, jigs, fixtures, moulds, and tools clean and ready; leave the line tidy so the next shift can start without trouble
* **Proto Support (for top performers)** — Work directly with engineers on first builds, fix fitment issues and share what you learn back to production
* **Continuous Improvement** — Suggest fixes when something is slow, error\-prone, or unsafe; small daily improvements add up

**Assembly Track:**
-------------------

* **Drone Assembly** — Build sub\-assemblies and full aircraft following SOPs \- fitting the airframe, mounting motors and ESCs, routing harnesses, placing sensors, and tightening fasteners to the right spec
* **Electrical \& Mechanical Work** — Crimping, soldering, building wire harnesses, and using torque tools across the aircraft
* **Adhesive Dispensing \& Surface Prep** — Comfort with using adhesive guns and doing surface prep like sanding is a strong plus

**Composites Track:**
---------------------

* **Composites Work** — Cut, place, and lay up carbon fibre and fibreglass layers into moulds as per the layup plan; work with resin systems, wet layup, and prepreg
* **Vacuum Bagging \& Curing** — Set up bagging materials, breather layers, and vacuum lines; remove air pockets and hold a full vacuum without leaks; run oven and autoclave cycles from start to finish

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Must\-Have**

* Excellent hand skills and a steady hand — able to work with small parts, fine wires, tight tolerances, or delicate layups without losing patience
* Comfort reading basic engineering drawings, parts lists, layup plans, and assembly instructions
* Ability to follow SOPs carefully while also speaking up when something doesn't look right
* Willingness to commute to or relocate near Hoskote
* For experienced candidates: Real hands\-on experience in assembly, fabrication, or composites — through past work or vocational training

**Good to Have**

* For freshers: Hands\-on experience through personal projects, vocational training, or internships
* ITI / Diploma in Fitter, Electronics Mechanic, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), or similar trade
* Past experience in drone, aerospace, EV, robotics, wind energy, marine FRP, or precision instrument manufacturing
* Familiarity with crimping, soldering, harness building, torque tools, adhesive dispensing, and sanding (Assembly Track) or prepreg carbon fibre, vacuum infusion, and autoclave work (Composites Track)
* Exposure to lean manufacturing, 5S, or production line ways of working

**Who You Are**
---------------

* Cares about getting the job done thoroughly
* Have an eye detail work and doesn't cut corners
* Comfortable asking questions when unsure
* Can focus through long, repetitive tasks
* Wants to work on drones that actually fly

**Compensation range:** **2 \- 3\.5 LPA (freshers), 3\.5 \- ₹4\.5 LPA (experienced candidates)**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*This is our estimated budget for this skillset and current market. Candidates expecting a higher CTC are encouraged to apply and share their expected CTC in the application form along with the skills and experience that justify it. Where a candidate lands within the salary range will depend on several factors including, but not limited to, skills, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, location, shift, and what the team needs.*

**Work Location:** **Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters)**
--------------------------------------------------------

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Comprehensive health insurance** to keep you and your loved ones covered
* **Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend** to ease your commute
* **Advanced salary credit** to support you when you need it
* Nutritious, wholesome **meals provided daily**


“A driven, passionate team where you’ll have room to grow and thrive \- **this is more than just a job, it’s a rare opportunity to build something meaningful** from the ground up”

**Work Schedule:**
------------------

* **1st \& 3rd weeks of the month:** Monday to Friday.
* **2nd, 4th \& 5th weeks of the month:** Monday to Saturday.

description:

**Job Description:**


We are looking for **passionate, energetic, and career\-driven freshers** to join our **Customer Support team** and begin their journey in a fast\-growing, customer\-first work environment.


As a **Customer Support Specialist,** you will work directly with employers hiring on Apna and support them across **calls, emails, and chats**. This role is perfect for candidates who enjoy **problem\-solving, communication, relationship\-building, and creating great customer experiences.**


The ideal candidate should have good communication skills in **English and Hindi**, a **customer\-first mindset**, a positive attitude, and a strong willingness to learn **CRM tools, support processes, digital platforms, and professional customer success practices.**

**Support Process Type:**  

Blended – Call Heavy/Open to chat and email

**Type of Employer Queries:**  

Churn Management, Reactivation of customer, Job posting queries.

 **Requirements** **Key Responsibilities:**

* This role gives you an opportunity to build strong customer support skills while working directly with employers and helping them resolve their queries.
* You will interact with employers through multiple channels such as calls, emails, and chats, and learn how to provide prompt, polite, and accurate support. You will handle customer concerns with professionalism, patience, and empathy while creating a positive customer experience.
* You will also get hands\-on exposure to digital tools such as CRM, ticketing systems, chat software, and other platforms. As part of the role, you will get the opportunity to coordinate with internal teams such as Product, Sales, Marketing, and IT to escalate and resolve employer issues efficiently.
* This role will help you understand customer problems, follow process guidelines, and provide effective solutions with confidence. It requires willingness to work in rostered shifts(Day Shift) and open to be on camera during working hours.
* This is a great opportunity for freshers to start their career in customer support, work with a highly professional team, improve business communication, and develop strong problem\-solving skills in a professional environment.

**Must\-Haves:**

* We are looking for enthusiastic freshers who are ready to take their first step into a professional customer support career.
* You should be a graduate with good communication skills in **English and Hindi,** and the confidence to interact with customers politely and professionally.
* A minimum typing speed of **30 WPM** and basic knowledge of tools like **Zoom, Google Meet, and online platforms** will help you perform smoothly in this role.
* You should have a laptop, stable Wi\-Fi connection of at least **30 Mbps,** and a dedicated work\-from\-home setup.
* This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable solving customer queries, learning new processes, and working in a front\-line support environment.
* You should be flexible to work in rotational shifts, weekends, and extended hours when required.
* Candidates who can join within 7 days will have an added advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Any internship or basic exposure to customer service, chat support, voice process, recruitment, CRM, or ticketing tools will be an added advantage.
* You should be able to understand customer concerns clearly and suggest suitable solutions with confidence.
* Good written communication skills will help you manage chat and email support professionally.
* A willingness to learn tools like Freshchat, CRM, ticketing systems, and internal platforms is important for success in this role.
* We are looking for a positive team player with a strong learning mindset, ownership attitude, and eagerness to grow in a professional customer support environment.

description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Design, implement, and maintain Linux\-based server infrastructures with a focus on reliability and scalability.
   

  

 Perform comprehensive system monitoring, diagnostics, and performance optimization
   

  

 Configure and manage network hardware, including switches, routers, and complex cabling systems
   

  

 Develop and maintain robust backup and disaster recovery strategies.
   

  

 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless technological integration.
   

  

**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)

title: Site HR Manager
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

 Could you be the full\-time Site HR Manager in Bangalore we’re looking for?
   

  

**Your future role**
 Take on a new challenge and apply your human resources expertise in a dynamic and collaborative environment. You’ll work alongside a dedicated and forward\-thinking team of professionals.
   

  

 You'll play a key role in shaping the employee experience and fostering a positive workplace culture. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with senior leaders, line managers, and employees across the business, providing professional HR support, ensuring adherence to company policies, and deploying Alstom HR initiatives. You’ll also work on workforce planning, talent development, and much more.
   

  

 You’ll specifically take care of aligning HR strategies with business objectives and driving employee engagement initiatives, but also ensuring compliance with labor laws and managing performance cycles.
   

  

 We’ll look to you for:
   

  

* Providing strategic HR guidance to business leaders and employees
* Ensuring the implementation of HR policies and processes in line with company standards
* Managing recruitment, onboarding, and succession planning
* Overseeing the implementation of salary reviews, incentive schemes, and job grading updates
* Coordinating training and talent development programs
* Fostering a culture of feedback, career development, and employee engagement
* Driving compliance with ethics and labor laws
* Supporting organizational change and communication initiatives
* Managing employee relations, including performance improvement and disciplinary processes


**All About You**
 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

* University degree in human resources, psychology, business studies, social sciences, or a related field
* MBA with a specialization in Human Resources (preferred)
* 15 to 20 years of HR experience in a comparable industry/environment, with at least 4 years as a Plant HR Manager
* Comprehensive understanding of Indian labor laws, employee relations, and payroll management
* Experience in managing HR operational aspects such as talent availability, salary and benefits, and compliance
* Strong organizational and communication skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook)
* Ability to influence, collaborate, and manage conflict effectively
* Business acumen and a proactive approach to problem\-solving

**Things you’ll enjoy**
 Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
   

  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from monotonous routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and supportive colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects that make a difference
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning programs
* Progress towards leadership opportunities within Alstom
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)


 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

**Important to note**
 As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: HR Manager - People & Culture
description:
**About Redwood** 




 Redwood Edutours designs learning journeys for school students across India and the world. We work with 50\+ leading IB and international schools, and over 30,000 students have traveled with us. Our programs are built around real places, real communities, and real learning — mapped to curriculum, co\-designed with teachers, and delivered by a team that cares deeply about what education can be.
 



  





 We've grown from a team of 8 to 35, and we're building toward 70\. As we scale, we need someone who can hold our culture through that growth — and build the infrastructure that makes it possible.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We're looking for an HR Manager who understands that in a small, fast\-moving team, HR isn't just process. It's culture.
 



  





 This role covers the full spectrum: recruitment, onboarding, performance, compliance, payroll, and employee wellbeing. You'll work closely with founders and team leads, and you'll own the HR function with real autonomy. Part of the job is managing what exists. The larger part is building what we'll need tomorrow.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




*Recruitment \& Onboarding* 



* Drive end\-to\-end hiring across roles — screening, interviews, offers, and onboarding
* Partner with team leads to define what we're looking for and why
* Design onboarding that embeds new hires into how Redwood works, not just paperwork



  





*Facilitator Community* 



* Own recruitment, onboarding, and contracting for Redwood's facilitator network — 120\+ professionals across ecology, history, art, education, outdoor facilitation, and more
* Work with the programs team to match expertise to each journey's needs
* Contribute to the long\-term vision for the community — how it grows, how people progress, and what a sustained relationship with Redwood can look like



  





*Culture \& Engagement* 



* Build feedback rhythms that are honest and useful — pulse surveys, review cycles, open conversations
* Support team wellbeing across field and office contexts
* Be the bridge between our field\-based facilitators and our office\-based team
* Facilitate team\-building that feels genuine, not performative



  





*Performance \& Growth* 



* Manage appraisal cycles, KPIs, and growth conversations
* Support managers in coaching, performance interventions, and role transitions



  





*HR Operations* 



* Maintain compliance with Indian labour law and statutory requirements
* Oversee payroll, benefits, compensation benchmarking, and policy documentation
* Handle grievances and disciplinary matters with fairness and confidentiality
* Build the SOPs and HR systems that will support us as we scale to 70\+
* Manage office administration, vendors, and asset tracking where needed



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 4–6 years in an HR Generalist or HR Manager role, ideally having seen a company scale from 20 to 100 people
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labour law, payroll processes, and HR tools
* Comfortable working cross\-functionally — with both field teams and office staff
* An empathetic communicator who can also hold difficult conversations when needed
* Comfortable with ambiguity — you don't wait for a manual, you write it
* Experience in a startup or mission\-driven environment is a real plus



  





**Why Redwood** 




 We came here because we believed in what education could be when it's designed with intention. Many of us are still here because that belief holds — and because the team makes the work worth doing.
 



 You're joining at a real inflection point. The role has autonomy, the work has purpose, and every person you bring in contributes directly to what we're building — for our team, and for the students we work with.
 



 If that's the kind of role you're looking for — we'd like to meet you.

Our team provides a multi\-language capability to the internal customers, and is looking for MHLS Associates with Italian and English to join us. Reporting to a Team Manager, the team acts as first point of contact for employees and managers via phone, live chat, email, and internal case management systems by answering Employee’s life\-cycle queries related to benefits, payroll, leave of absence, data management, onboarding and terminations as well as processing absence reporting requests.
   

  

 As an HR Professional, you are someone who is skilled at building positive relationships with employees and colleagues. You are approachable and able to handle sensitive situations with tact and diplomacy. You pride yourself on maintaining high ethical standards and confidentiality when dealing with sensitive employee information, conflicts of interest, and compliance issues.

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Handle and resolve HR queries in Italian and English by referring to documentation such as frequently asked questions and standard operating procedures and escalate where these cannot be resolved.

* 0\-10\+ years’ experience in contact center, customer service, human resources or equivalent experience.
* Schedule flexibility (support a 24x7 operations).
* Internet connection before joining date with a speed range of 50\-100 Mbps.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Relevant work experience in administration, customer service/ call center or HR environment.
* Very good proficiency in additional European languages.
* Ability to work in international teams where team members are in different locations and belong to different cultures.
* Ability to work with confidential information
* Flexibility to work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Good interpersonal, communication, time management, and problem\-solving skills.

title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
**Job Profile:\-**




 We are looking for a highly motivated fresher or early\-career professional to join our engineering team as an
 **Intern \- Software Engineer.** 




 This role involves handling high\-frequency technical issues, performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA), coordinating with cross\-functional teams, and ensuring timely fixes in production systems.
 



  





 Over time, the candidate will be trained to independently debug, optimize, and gradually transition into core development responsibilities.
 



  





**Key Attributes you need to possess: \-**



* Identify, analyze, and troubleshoot production issues in real\-time.
* Perform quick and accurate Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* Fix minor to moderate code issues independently.
* Communicate complex issues clearly to the main development team when escalation is required.
* Coordinate with multiple Project Managers for issue tracking and resolution updates.
* Ensure timely release of fixes after validation.
* Maintain proper documentation of issues, RCA, and resolutions.
* Monitor logs, databases, and application performance metrics.
* Participate in deployment and hotfix releases when required.
* Continuously improve debugging speed and production stability.



  





**Skills Required:**




  





**Technical Skills:**



* Basic understanding of backend development (Node.js preferred based on your stack).
* Strong debugging and logical problem\-solving skills.
* Understanding of databases (MongoDB / SQL / NoSQL).
* Familiarity with APIs and backend architecture.
* Basic understanding of logs, error tracking, and production monitoring.
* Knowledge of Git and version control.
* Basic understanding of realtime communication using WebSockets.
* Familiarity with Redis for caching and handling realtime data/events.



  





**Soft Skills:**



* Strong ownership mindset.
* Ability to handle pressure in high\-frequency issue environments.
* Clear and structured communication.
* Ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders.
* Strong analytical thinking.



  





**Qualifications:**



* B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA or equivalent technical degree.
* 0–1 year of experience in software development or support.
* Freshers with a strong debugging mindset and internships are encouraged to apply.



  





**Growth Path:**




 This role is designed as a high\-impact learning track:
 



**Stage 1:** 




 → Issue triaging \& structured RCA
 



 → Fixing small bugs \& production patches
 



**Stage 2:** 




 → Independent handling of moderate backend fixes
 



 → System\-level debugging
 



**Stage 3:** 




 → Transition into core development
 



 → Feature implementation \& ownership
 



  





 High performers will gradually move into backend development roles once product stability improves.
 



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile:**



* Someone who Loves solving problems quickly.
* Enjoys debugging more than writing new features initially.
* Wants to deeply understand systems.
* Aspires to become a strong backend developer.



  





**What you can expect from ORI:\-**



* Passion \& happiness in the workplace with great people \& open culture with amazing growth opportunities.

title: Associate QA Engineer - Fresher
description:
We are looking for a detail\-oriented, analytical, and highly motivated 
 **Associate QA Engineer** 
  to join our engineering team. In this role, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our software applications. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and senior QA engineers to learn the product ecosystem, execute test cases, identify bugs, and slowly transition into building automated test suites.
 



 This is a foundational role with a clear career progression path into advanced manual testing, automation engineering, or performance testing.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 * **Test Execution \& Documentation:** 
  Review software requirements, user stories, and technical design documents to create comprehensive, well\-structured test plans and test cases.
* **Defect Tracking:** 
  Execute manual functional, regression, sanity, and UI/UX testing. Document, track, and prioritize software bugs with clear, reproducible steps using project management tools.
* **Collaboration:** 
  Work alongside cross\-functional development teams to understand feature requirements and isolate issues. Participate in sprint planning and daily standups.
* **Automation Learning Curve:** 
  Assist in maintaining existing automation test scripts and gradually learn to write basic automated tests under the guidance of senior team members.
* **Quality Advocacy:** 
  Act as a champion for the end\-user experience, ensuring that software updates do not break existing workflows.



  




 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 * **Education:** 
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (recent graduates welcome).
* **Foundational Knowledge:** 
  Solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* **Analytical Mindset:** 
  Excellent logical thinking, debugging, and problem\-solving skills with a sharp eye for edge cases and UI inconsistencies.
* **Communication** 
 : Strong written and verbal communication skills to document complex technical bugs clearly and concisely.



**Technical Familiarity:** 



* **Basic knowledge of databases and ability to write simple SQL queries to verify data.**
* Familiarity with at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Java) is a strong plus.
* Basic understanding of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JSON, APIs).
* **Tools (Good to Have / Training Provided):** 
  Familiarity with tools like Jira, Postman (for API testing), JMeter (for performance testing), or basic exposure to automation frameworks (Selenium, Playwright) is an advantage.



  




 What We Look For in a Fresher
 **The "Trainability" Factor:** 
  We do not expect you to know everything on day one. We value curiosity, a strong work ethic, a passion for technology, and the ability to absorb feedback and learn new tools rapidly.
   

 What We Offer
 * Structured mentorship program with senior engineering talent.
* Hands\-on experience with modern QA automation tools and frameworks.
* Clear career growth path toward Senior QA or SDET roles.
* Collaborative and inclusive team culture.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 





 Wekalp is a Data Intelligence and Automation Platform that enables AI agents to act on reliable, governed enterprise data. Our living semantic layer captures the context of how businesses actually run — and surfaces it as conversational intelligence, automated pipelines, and board\-ready insights. We currently serve BFSI and CPG enterprises, are CERT\-IN certified and provide flexible deployment options across customer, shared, or on\-premise cloud.
 




  





 Key responsibilities
 


* Administer Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes (OKD) clusters — installation, upgrades, operators, ingress, RBAC, networking, and security policies.
* Design and manage AWS infrastructure (EKS, EC2, S3, RDS, Route 53\) including IAM, VPC, and security groups.
 
  Wekalp's data and storage layer is platform\-native — this role manages the infrastructure it runs on, not AWS data services
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions) for containerized microservice and platform deployments.
* Deploy and operate Wekalp's platform in customer\-managed environments — on\-premise data centres and customer clouds (AWS, Azure, or GCP tenants) — including air\-gapped setups, private networking constraints, and customer\-specific security policies.
* Own cross\-environment interoperability: ensure consistent platform behaviour, configuration parity, and upgrade paths across Wekalp\-hosted and customer\-hosted deployments.
* Manage AWS Bedrock service integration — API availability, request routing, IAM permission boundaries, and cost monitoring for inference workloads.
* Support deployment and connectivity of MCP servers that we build for enterprise customers integrating with Claude — including networking, auth, and endpoint reliability.
* Ensure observability across platform services: Prometheus, Grafana dashboards covering infra health, API latency, and Bedrock usage metric



**Qualifications** 



* 2–4 years of hands\-on DevOps or platform engineering experience.
* Proficient with Red Hat OpenShift or Kubernetes cluster administration.
* AWS infrastructure experience: EKS, EC2, Route 53, IAM, and VPC. Note: Wekalp's data and storage layer is platform\-native — familiarity with AWS compute and networking is what's needed, not AWS data services
* Experience deploying software into customer\-managed environments — on\-premise or private cloud — including handling restricted networks, custom TLS, and enterprise proxy configurations
* CI/CD pipeline design using Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions. Docker and container image lifecycle management.
* Linux administration, cloud networking, and security fundamentals.
* Familiarity with Prometheus \+ Grafana and ELK/EFK logging stacks.
* Automation using
 **Ansible or scripting (Bash/Python)**
* Working knowledge of AWS Bedrock — how it's invoked, how access is controlled, and how costs are tracked across foundation model API calls.
* Awareness of MCP (Model Context Protocol) — what it does, how servers expose data to AI agents, and how to keep those connections reliable and secure in an enterprise context.
* Cost\-conscious mindset — especially for variable inference workloads on managed AI services.
* Strong troubleshooting instincts and ability to collaborate across data, AI, and product teams

* Productivity Suites: Office 365 and Google Workspace
* Collaboration \& AV: Zoom and modern AV equipment
* Service Management: Enterprise\-level IT service management tools


**Why Join Wrike?**
* 18 calendar days of paid vacation
* 12 days of National \& Festival holidays (10 fixed, 2 flexible)
* Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)
* Menstrual Leave: Twelve (12\) days per calendar year. Women employees are eligible for up to 1 day of menstrual leave per month.
* Parental Leave: 26 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity
* 2 Volunteer Days
* Group Medical Insurance (Employees \+ Dependents)
* Term Life Insurance (Rs 50,00,000\)
* Personal Accident Insurance (Rs 50,00,000\)
* Monthly Broadband / Internet Reimbursement (INR 1500\)
* Hybrid Working Model \+ Complimentary Lunch \& Snacks

* Department Interview \- 60 Mins (face to face interview)
* Additional Interview \- 60 mins (virtual interview)
* Final Interview \- 60 mins (face to face interview)


 Your recruitment buddy will be Nandini Singh, Sourcing Recruiter.
   

  

**Who Is Wrike And Our Culture**
 We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
   

  

**Hybrid work mode**
 Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000\+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co\-working spaces across many locations.
   

  

 While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in\-person collaboration and connection.
   

  

**Our persona**
**💡 Smart:** 
 We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
   

  

**💚 Dedicated:** 
 We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
   

  

**🤗 Approachable:** 
 We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.
   

  

**Our culture and Values**
**🤩 Customer\-Focused**
**We care about our customers.** 
 We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision\-making and action\-taking are done with the customer in mind.
   

  

**🤝 Collaborative**
**We work as one and win together,** 
 each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.
   

  

**🎨 Creative**
**We strive to succeed through continuous innovation.** 
 It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.
   

  

**💪 Committed**
**We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization,** 
 by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.
   

  

 Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

title: System Administrator
description:
**About CynLr** 




  





 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to
 **instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. Demo Video** 




 Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to
 **assemble a Smartphone** 
 or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.
 



 CynLr\-enabled visual robots intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on\-the\-fly, eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre\-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into modular LEGO\-like micro\-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



 At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are deeply inspired by neuroscience, modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



 This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 As a
 *System Administrator at CynLr* 
 , you will design, build, and evolve IT infrastructure, processes, and practices that support research, product development, and operations, while ensuring efficient, secure, and sustainable usage. Process for the sake of process will not be entertained;
 *utility and convenience take precedence, and every system must justify its existence by improving real outcomes.* 





  





 CynLr's ambition demands not only breakthrough algorithms and hardware, but also a
 *robust, adaptive, and human\-centric IT infrastructure* 
 that allows teams to operate with minimal friction and maximum focus. As CynLr scales across disciplines, tools, and geographies,
 *IT infrastructure becomes the information backbone of the organization.* 
 The goal of this role is not merely uptime or compliance, but to
 *augment human productivity* 
 , eliminate hidden delays and context\-switching costs, and ensure that technology remains an enabler rather than a constraint.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***A. Operate***




  




* Run and maintain IT infrastructure supporting research, engineering, and operations at scale.
* Administer the Office 365 ecosystem (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, identity and access).
* Operate and secure endpoint devices across Windows, Android, BYOD, and corporate assets.
* Manage network infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, and VPNs.
* Perform hands\-on monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution across hardware, OS, network, and applications.



  





***B. Build***




  




* Design and deploy Azure AD, Intune, and SharePoint policies for secure and organized access.
* Set up and maintain hardware infrastructure—laptops, workstations, servers, networking, and conferencing systems.
* Configure and support Windows Server, Linux, virtualization platforms (VMware / Hyper\-V).
* Establish remote workflows and inter\-office connectivity to enable distributed teams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with hardware, software, and service vendors.



  





***C. Improve***



* Automate workflows and remediation using PowerShell scripting to reduce manual effort.
* Evaluate and select hardware and software based on supportability, ecosystem maturity, scalability, and lifecycle cost.
* Proactively monitor systems, analyse failures, and implement preventive and reliability improvements.
* Continuously refine IT processes and practices to remove friction and improve user productivity.



  





**Team Structure:** 



* The Operations team at CynLr functions as a
 *cross\-functional enablement layer* 
 that supports Engineering, Product, and Business teams in executing reliably and at scale. Within this structure, Technology and Systems responsibilities are owned as a core operational capability, ensuring that digital infrastructure, tools, and access evolve in step with how the organization works.
* Systems and IT operations are designed to be
 *deeply integrated into day\-to\-day execution* 
 , preserving context across teams and workflows. The function works closely with Engineering to support research and development needs, and with Operations and Finance to ensure reliability, security, and long\-term sustainability.



  





**What You’ll Need to Do This Well** 



* Strong understanding of computer hardware and workstations: CPU, memory, storage, BIOS/firmware and
 *how configuration choices impact developer productivity and system reliability.*
* Deep familiarity with
 *office productivity and collaboration systems,* 
 and the ability to
 *design workflows that reduce friction and context switching* 
 rather than add process overhead.
* Solid grounding in
 *networking fundamentals* 
 (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls) relevant to office, lab, and inter\-office environments.
* Clear understanding of
 *device configuration, identity management, and user access policies, balancing usability with security.*
* Working knowledge of
 *security principles, data protection, and basic database concepts,* 
 sufficient to design safe and scalable internal systems.



  





**Experience That Will Accelerate You** 



* Hands\-on experience with
 *DevOps or internal tooling infrastructure* 
 , especially in environments where tooling is still evolving.
* Experience setting up and maintaining databases or data services used internally by teams.
* Exposure to building IT systems in
 *fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environments where requirements change frequently.*
* *Experience supporting engineering\-heavy teams* 
 , including compute\-intensive workflows, development environments, and high\-performance workstations



  





**What will you do?** 



* You will design and operate the
 *digital infrastructure that enables CynLr’s teams to work without friction* 
 . Your role is to ensure that systems, tools, and access models support how people actually work across research, engineering, operations, and business functions.
* You will
 *translate organizational needs into reliable, secure, and intuitive IT systems, spanning devices, networks, collaboration tools, identity, and internal workflows* 
 . From onboarding a new team member to supporting compute\-heavy engineering setups, your work ensures that infrastructure never becomes the bottleneck to progress.
* You will proactively identify inefficiencies, hidden delays, and context\-switching costs in everyday workflows, and redesign systems to remove them so that teams can focus on solving hard problems, not fighting tools.



  





**How will you do it?** 



* The role demands a
 *systems\-first, entrepreneurial approach* 
 , suited to a deep\-tech environment where requirements evolve rapidly and standard enterprise playbooks often fall short.
* You will build strong context by working closely with teams, understanding how infrastructure decisions affect productivity, security, and reliability. You will question existing practices when they add friction, and design modular, scalable solutions that can adapt as CynLr grows.
* You will have the autonomy to rethink how systems are designed, deployed, and operated, with outcomes reviewed through the lens of
 *execution quality, reliability, usability, and long\-term sustainability.* 
 Success in this role comes from balancing hands\-on execution with thoughtful design solving today’s problems while building infrastructure that remains robust tomorrow.

title: Network LAN Engineer [T500-26167]
description:
**About ADM:** 




 We are one of the world’s largest nutrition companies and a global leader in human and animal nutrition. We unlock the power of nature to provide nourishing quality of life by transforming crops into ingredients and solutions for foods, beverages, supplements, livestock, aquaculture, and pets.
 



  





**About ADM India Hub:** 




 At ADM, we have long recognized the strength and potential of India’s talent pool, which is why we have maintained a presence in the country for more than 25 years. Building on this foundation, we have now established ADM India Hub, our first GCC in India.
 



 At ADM India Hub, we are hiring for IT and finance roles across diverse technology and business functions. We stand at the intersection of global expertise and local excellence, enabling us to drive innovation and support our larger purpose of unlocking the power of nature to enrich quality of life.
 



  





**POSITION DETAILS:** 




**Job Title: Local Area Network (LAN) Engineer** 




**Department: Network Infrastructure** 




**Employment Type: Full\-Time, Permanent** 




**Level: Senior / Lead** 




**Min. LAN Experience: 7 Years – Architecture \& Design** 




**Min. Cisco Experience: 5 Years – Routing \& Switching.** 




  





**ROLE OVERVIEW:** 




 The Local Area Network Engineer is a senior technical role responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, and ongoing optimization of the enterprise LAN environment. Reporting directly to the Network Manager, this individual will serve as the primary subject matter expert across LAN infrastructure, Cisco SD\-WAN (Viptela), routing and switching protocols, and network automation. The role demands a hands\-on engineer with a strong track record of leading complex network projects in multi\-site enterprise environments.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** 



* Lead end\-to\-end architecture and design of enterprise LAN environments, ensuring high availability, performance, and security across all sites.
* Deploy, manage, and optimize Cisco Viptela SD\-WAN solutions including policy configuration, template management, and multi\-site orchestration.
* Configure and maintain Cisco switching and routing infrastructure, including OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, VLAN segmentation, STP/RSTP, HSRP, and VRRP.
* Collaborate with the Network Manager and cross\-functional teams to define network strategy and long\-term infrastructure roadmap.
* Conduct network capacity planning, traffic analysis, and performance tuning to consistently meet or exceed defined SLAs.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation including topology diagrams, HLD/LLD designs, runbooks, and change management records.
* Lead root cause analysis for complex network incidents and drive implementation of permanent corrective and preventive actions.
* Evaluate and recommend new networking technologies, vendor solutions, and best practices to continuously improve the environment.
* Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and contribute to team knowledge sharing and upskilling initiatives.
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical network incidents and planned maintenance activities.



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** 




**Experience \& Technical Skills (Must Have):** 



* Minimum 7 years of hands\-on experience in LAN architecture and design within complex, multi\-site enterprise environments.
* Minimum 5 years of direct experience with Cisco networking platforms, specifically enterprise\-grade switching and routing hardware and software.
* Proven, demonstrable expertise with Cisco Viptela SD\-WAN — including design, deployment, vManage policy configuration, and advanced troubleshooting.
* Deep working knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocols: VLANs, 802\.1Q, STP/RSTP/MSTP, HSRP/VRRP, OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP.
* Strong practical experience with Cisco Catalyst and Nexus switching platforms in production environments.
* Proven ability to produce detailed network designs, high\-level designs (HLD), low\-level designs (LLD), and comprehensive solution proposals.
* Solid understanding of network security principles including ACLs, microsegmentation, firewall integration, and Zero Trust concepts.
* Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to isolate and resolve complex, multi\-layer network issues under pressure.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.



  





**NICE TO HAVE:** 



* **Cisco Certification:** 
 CCNP Enterprise, CCNP SD\-WAN, or CCIE strongly preferred. Any current and valid Cisco certification will be viewed positively.
* **Cisco DNA Center (DNAC):** 
 Hands\-on experience with Cisco DNAC for intent\-based networking, network assurance, device provisioning, and automated policy management.
* **Python API Integration with Cisco DNAC:** 
 Ability to develop Python\-based scripts and automation workflows leveraging Cisco DNA Center REST APIs for device management, telemetry, and reporting.
* **SolarWinds:** 
 Experience with SolarWinds Network Performance Monitor (NPM) and/or Network Configuration Manager (NCM) for SNMP\-based monitoring, alerting, and configuration compliance.
* **API Integration – SolarWinds \& DNAC via Python:** 
 Ability to build integrated automation pipelines combining SolarWinds and Cisco DNAC APIs using Python to create unified monitoring dashboards, automated incident responses, and cross\-platform reporting.
* **Network Automation Frameworks:** 
 Familiarity with Ansible, Terraform, or NetBox for infrastructure\-as\-code practices and automated network provisioning workflows.



  





**WHAT WE OFFER:** 




**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER:** 




 We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of background, identity, or experience. Applicants must be authorized to work in the applicable jurisdiction without visa sponsorship unless otherwise stated.
 


* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience and qualifications.
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and retirement plans.
* Professional development budget with full financial support for Cisco certification exam fees and training.
* Collaborative, engineer\-first culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Flexible hybrid work arrangements with a focus on work\-life balance.
* Access to cutting\-edge network infrastructure, tooling, and lab environments.
* Clear career progression pathways within the Network Infrastructure and broader IT organization.

title: Network Engineer, Capacity Restoration Team
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 As a Network Engineer on CRT, you execute capacity restoration workflows across Amazon’s global network. You troubleshoot link and device failures. You coordinate with cross\-functional teams. You drive TTR down for out\-of\-service capacity. This role is focused on operational execution using existing tools and processes. You work at the component level, solving straightforward problems with guidance from your team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Execute link restoration workflows for Regional Border and Backbone spans.
* Troubleshoot hardware and software failures on network devices.
* Coordinate with carriers, colocation providers, and data center technicians on repairs.
* Monitor capacity health using operational event monitoring systems, network health monitoring systems, and workflow orchestration engines.
* Perform device health checks and link tests to validate restoration.
* Maintain accurate records of restoration progress, backlog status, and TTR metrics.
* Identify patterns in recurring failures and escalate to engineering teams.
* Contribute to operational runbooks and process documentation.
* Participate in on\-call rotations for follow\-the\-sun coverage.


 A day in the life
   

  

* Monitor capacity health dashboards and respond to out\-of\-service alerts
* Troubleshoot hardware/software failures on backbone and border network devices
* Execute restoration workflows using established automation and runbooks
* Coordinate with carriers, colocation providers, and data center technicians on link repairs
* Document incidents and contribute to post\-event reviews
* Participate in on\-call rotations supporting high severity calls and operational events.


**About The Team**
 The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) sits within Backbone, Enterprise, Regional Engineering (BERE) organization. Our mission is to own end\-to\-end restoration of out\-of\-service inter\-metro and intra\-metro network capacity.
   

  

 CRT reduces operational backlog, improves network health monitoring systems, and drives time\-to\-remediate (TTR) down. Today, a significant network capacity is out of service at any given time. The operational workload is capacity related and heavily manual and we are building the team and automation to change that.

We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

**Job Title: Network Engineer I – Core Network \& F5 (2nd Shift)**
**Job Summary**
 LPL is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Network Engineer to lead and support the core network infrastructure across office locations and data centers. This role will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, and load balancing solutions, with a strong emphasis on Cisco technologies and F5 load balancers.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise, exceptional troubleshooting skills, and hands\-on experience with network monitoring and performance optimization tools. This position is critical to delivering scalable, resilient, and secure networking solutions that support LPL, our advisors, and their clients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deploy, and manage core network infrastructure including LAN, WAN, and WiFi across office and data center environments
* Configure and maintain Cisco routers, switches, Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC), and Nexus platforms.
* Build and manage F5 LTM VIPs, iRule, perform health monitoring, and troubleshoot application delivery issues.
* Troubleshoot complex issues, identifying root causes, and developing continuous improvement of the environment
* Effectively collaborate with various Teams within the organization as well as external vendors and partners to support business needs and ensure network scalability and reliability.
* Conduct packet captures and deep\-dive analysis using tools like ExtraHop and LiveWire.
* Monitor network performance and availability using SolarWinds, Cisco DNA Center, and Thousand Eyes.
* Participate in capacity planning, network optimization, and incident response.
* Document network diagram, configurations, and operational procedures.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in enterprise network engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Cisco routing and switching technologies.
* Proven expertise in F5 LTM configuration and troubleshooting.
* Experience with SD\-WAN solutions and wireless network design.
* Familiarity with network monitoring and diagnostic tools.
* Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and lead network initiatives.


**Core Competencies**
* Deep understanding of TCP/IP, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), and VLANs.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects.
* Effective collaboration with internal teams and external vendors.
* Commitment to documentation and process improvement.
* Solid knowledge and experience in well\-known protocols and standards (i.e. VLANs, Spanning\-Tree, OSPF, BGP, HSRPDNS, 802\.1x)


**Preferred Technologies \& Tools**
* Networking: Cisco Routers, Switches, WLC, Nexus, SD\-WAN
* Load Balancing: F5 LTM
* Monitoring \& Diagnostics: SolarWinds, Cisco DNA Center, ThousandEyes, ExtraHop, LiveWire
* Automation tools: Terraform, Ansible

description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 As a Network Engineer on the Capacity Restoration Team, you bring experience and autonomy to own end\-to\-end capacity restoration for assigned network segments. You drive complex troubleshooting across multiple failure domains, mentor engineers, define and improve operational processes, and partner with engineering teams to address systemic resilience gaps. You apply correct technologies and best practices to complex problems, and your scope of influence spans the full team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Operational Execution**
* Own capacity restoration outcomes for assigned network segments, driving TTR reduction and backlog elimination.
* Lead complex, multi\-party troubleshooting for link and device failures spanning carriers, colocations, and internal teams.
* Participate in war rooms for critical events breaching container or region SLA thresholds.
* Participate in on\-call rotations for follow\-the\-sun coverage.


**Process And Operations Improvement**
* Define and improve operational processes and runbooks for restoration workflows.
* Analyze restoration metrics (TTR, backlog depth, network health score impact) to identify trends and drive improvements.
* Drive vendor accountability for carrier and colocation\-related restoration delays.


**Cross\-Team Collaboration**
* Partner with Topology Engineering, Capacity Engineering, and fabric engineering teams to address systemic issues.
* Represent Capacity Restoration Team in cross\-organizational reviews and operational planning.


**Mentorship And Development**
* Mentor and develop Network Engineers, providing technical guidance and review.
* Contribute to hiring loops and technical assessments.


 A day in the life
   

  

* Lead complex capacity restoration events involving multiple network layers and cross\-region links.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and develop remediation plans for recurring failures.
* Improve operational processes, runbooks, and escalation procedures based on observed patterns.
* Mentor engineers and conduct knowledge transfer sessions.
* Coordinate with engineering teams on platform readiness and design validation.
* Drive vendor and carrier accountability for restoration delays.
* Represent Capacity Restoration Team in cross\-organizational reviews and operational planning.
* Participate in war rooms for major events breaching container or region SLA thresholds.


**About The Team**
 The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) sits within Backbone, Enterprise, Regional Engineering (BERE) organization. Our mission is to own end\-to\-end restoration of out\-of\-service inter\-metro and intra\-metro network capacity.
   

  

 CRT reduces operational backlog, improves network health monitoring systems, and drives time\-to\-remediate (TTR) down. Today, a significant network capacity is out of service at any given time. The operational workload is capacity related and heavily manual and we are building the team and automation to change that.
   

  

 We operate across Seattle, Dublin, Hyderabad, and Sydney for follow\-the\-sun coverage. CRT acts as the connective layer between Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams.
   

  

**About Aws**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and Amaze Con (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience driving improvement programs in the operations, engineering and support fields
* Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field
* 5\+ years of computer networking experience
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems, or experience in managing and troublshooting network
* Experience with BGP, OSPF, or IS\-IS in large\-scale network environments.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in managing critical operational processes, with SLA responsibility
* Experience mentoring or training the engineering community on complex technical issues
* 1\+ years of fiber handling and fiber installation processes experience, or experience with fiber optic and copper cabling standards, testing equipment \& troubleshooting methodologies
* CCNA or equivalent level networking certification, or Bachelor's degree
* Experience with network performance analysis (TCP tuning, ECMP, traffic engineering).
* Experience with carrier coordination and maintenance management.


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
Long Description
   

  

 Role\- IOT Applications\-
   

  

 Experience \- 1\-3 Year
   

  

 Notice Period \- Immediate\-30 Days
   

  

 Location \- Noida/Pune/Bengaluru/Chennai/Mumbai
   

  

**Job Description**
 The IoT Applications Engineer (Grade 4A) will be responsible for developing, configuring, and supporting IoT\-based applications integrated with MES and shop floor systems. The role focuses on application development, device integration, data acquisition, and basic analytics to enable smart manufacturing and connected operations. This position requires close collaboration with senior engineers, architects, and manufacturing stakeholders.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 IoT Application Development \& Support
   

  

* Develop and enhance IoT applications for Industrial IoT (IIoT) use cases such as machine monitoring, OEE, energy monitoring, and asset tracking.
* Implement data ingestion pipelines from IoT devices, PLCs, sensors, and gateways into IoT platforms.
* Configure and customize dashboards, reports, and alerts for shop floor and MES users.
* Perform unit testing, basic integration testing, and support UAT activities.


 MES \& Industrial Integration
   

  

* Integrate IoT applications with MES, SCADA, ERP, and other manufacturing systems.
* Support connectivity using industrial protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, MQTT, REST APIs).
* Assist in deployment and configuration of edge devices and IoT gateways.


 Data Handling \& Monitoring
   

  

* Handle time series data storage and retrieval for IoT applications.
* Support basic data analytics, visualization, and anomaly detection use cases.
* Monitor application performance and troubleshoot issues related to connectivity, data flow, and device communication.


 Collaboration \& Documentation
   

  

* Work closely with solution architects, senior engineers, and functional consultants.
* Prepare technical documentation including application flows, configuration guides, and deployment notes.
* Follow defined coding standards, security guidelines, and DevOps practices.


 Mandatory Skills
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

  

* Basic to intermediate experience with IoT application development.
* Hands\-on exposure to IoT platforms (Azure IoT, AWS IoT, ThingWorx, Siemens MindSphere, or similar).
* Programming knowledge in Python / Java / Node.js / .NET (any one).
* Understanding of industrial communication protocols: MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus, REST APIs.
* Knowledge of MES concepts and manufacturing processes.
* Experience with SQL / NoSQL databases and time\-series data.
* Basic understanding of cloud services, containers, or edge computing concepts.


 Tools \& Technologies (Any exposure)
   

  

* IoT dashboards \& visualization tools
* Linux basics
* Git / version control
* CI/CD basics (Azure DevOps, GitHub, etc.)


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Strong analytical and problem solving skills
* Ability to learn new technologies quickly
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Team\-oriented mindset and willingness to work in cross\-functional teams
* Customer centric approach

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full\-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.
   

  

 TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.
   

  

**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium\-size customers. So if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.**

 The Associate Product Manager will assist with the research, design and development of product solutions to support the needs of TriNet clients, work site employees, and colleagues.
