title: Associate Product Manager
description:
We're building the future of hybrid work at peopleHum and we need an Associate PM who's obsessed with quality, accountability, and shipping great product. You'll report to the Head of Product, drive roadmap execution, spend serious time with customers, and own features end\-to\-end — from PRD to UAT to production. We're actively building in the AI and Agentic space, so a genuine curiosity for AI tools and workflows is non\-negotiable.
   

  

 W H A T Y O U ' L L D O
   

  

* Report to and collaborate with the Head of Product to develop strategies that expand peopleHum into new markets, positioning it as a leading HCM platform for the hybrid work model.
* Drive roadmap execution to rapidly expand the product suite and create sustainable product differentiation — moving fast without cutting quality corners.
* Spend a disproportionate amount of time with customers and prospects — informing product vision, co\- innovating on solutions, and bringing the outside\-in perspective to every roadmap decision.
* Define your features completely — write PRDs, specs, and user stories with full ownership of your modules. Engineers should be able to build from your documents without constant back\-and\-forth.
* Manage daily workflow with a team of engineers and designers, unblocking sprint ceremonies and enabling clear decision\-making.
* Own UAT before every production release — write test cases, catch regressions and edge cases, and sign off on quality. You are the last line of defence before customers see the product. MUST HAVE
* Analyse the effectiveness of shipped features — track usage, identify failure points, and define iterative improvements to reduce drop\-offs and increase adoption.
* Own every task assigned to you — follow through without reminders, communicate blockers early, and close the loop with stakeholders.
* Represent your team in communication with product, engineering, design, and marketing leadership — be a clear, structured voice for your squad.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* MBA is a plus, particularly if paired with strong technical depth.


 Must have skills
   

  

* 1–3 years of product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment — you understand enterprise workflows, multi\-stakeholder selling, and longer feedback cycles.
* A quality\-obsessed mindset — you've personally run UATs, written test cases, and taken accountability for what ships to production.
* Passion for building delightful products with an eye for design — you have intuition for good user flows, UX detail, and can articulate what 'well\-crafted' means.
* Demonstrated accountability and ownership: you close tasks, not just open them. You flag risks early and follow up proactively.
* Strong prioritization instincts — you can triage a messy backlog, say no clearly, and explain tradeoffs to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a talent for precise articulation of customer problems — vague specs are not acceptable.
* Technical fluency — ability to gain an in\-depth understanding of software systems, work comfortably with engineers on architecture discussions, and make meaningful technical contributions.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools daily — Cursor, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Notion AI, or similar — and a genuine curiosity for how these tools work.
* Working understanding of LLM\-based products — prompt design, RAG architectures, AI agents, and the failure modes unique to AI systems (hallucinations, latency, eval metrics).


 Good to have skills
   

  

* Understanding of the HCM (human capital management) space and enterprise SaaS — highly desirable but not a blocker if everything else fits.
* Experience with tools like JIRA, Linear, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Figma, and Notion.
* Exposure to API\-first or developer\-facing B2B products.
* Basic SQL or data querying ability to self\-serve on product analytics.
* Prior experience shipping features that included an AI or ML component.

title: Associate Product Manager(APM)
description:
EnglishBhashi is a revolutionary language learning platform that empowers individuals to enhance their spoken skills. As a Product\-Based EdTech Company, we are dedicated to delivering hyper\-personalized and impactful learning experiences. With ambitious goals for scaling, innovation, and user engagement, we’re looking for a driven and versatile Product \& Growth Intern to join our dynamic team.
   

  

**This is a high\-ownership, founder\-style role; you will shape the product from the ground up.**
**Location:** 
 HSR, Bengaluru
   

  

**Working:** 
 Monday to Saturday
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 This is a dynamic role that will require you to wear multiple hats and work across various domains, including product development, marketing, research, and design. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

**Product Discovery \& User Research**
* Conduct deep user research with Tier 2/3/4 learners (interviews, surveys, usability tests).

**Job Summary**

This role focuses on developing high‑quality knowledge articles, transforming support handover videos into structured learning modules, and qualifying the communication standards of support engineers through the review of customer interactions. The role requires excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong learning agility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with support, training, and enablement stakeholders.

 Knowledge Content Development

* Ensure system requirements are reviewed, approved, and published in line with release milestones and internal governance processes.
* Proactively track upcoming releases and identify content dependencies, risks, or gaps that could impact support readiness.
* Act as the communication bridge between product teams and support to ensure system requirements are clearly understood and consistently communicated.


 Training and Enablement Content
   

  

* Convert support handover videos, recordings, and walkthroughs into structured learning modules, reference guides, and written documentation.
* Create a Case Journal or Case Lifecycle modules based on existing support Guidelines, Standard Work Instructions.
* Collaborate with Support Enablement and Learning \& Development teams to align content with training objectives and onboarding needs.

* Work closely with Support Engineers, Support Managers and Team Leaders, Product Teams, and Enablement partners to ensure content accuracy and relevance.
* Act as a communication subject‑matter partner for standardizing messaging across support channels.

* Excellent written communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts into clear, user\-friendly content.
* Experience in developing knowledge base articles, and training materials.
* Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with support teams, and product stakeholders to gather and validate information.
* Strong attention to detail with solid research, structuring, and content quality assurance capabilities.

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
* Proven expertise in writing knowledge articles, support documentation, and learning content.
* Strong analytical ability to evaluate communication quality and identify improvement areas.


 Professional Competencies
   

  

* High learning agility with the ability to rapidly understand new products and processes.
* Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills, with confidence in working across teams and functions.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple content initiatives while meeting deadlines.
* Collaborates effectively with cross\-functional teams to establish and nurture strong working relationships.


**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1 to 2 years experience working with support teams, SaaS products, or technical/customer support environments.
* Familiarity with video editing tools like Camtasia, Articulate is a plus.
* Knowledge of Salesforce, Confluence is an added advantage.
* Prior experience in communication quality review, training content creation, or enablement is an advantage.

* Improved clarity, consistency, and usability of support knowledge articles.
* Effective transformation of support knowledge into reusable learning modules.
* Measurable improvement in support engineers’ communication quality and customer interaction scores.
* Positive feedback from support, enablement, and leadership stakeolders.

title: AI Business Analyst
description:
**Job Title: Business Analyst** 




**Location:** 

 Hyderabad (Hybrid Work Model)                                                     
 




**Experience:** 

 4 to 7 years
 




**Type:** 

 Full\-Time
   






**About the Role** 




 We are not looking for someone who just documents requirements. We want someone who can walk into a client room, earn trust fast, ask the right questions, and translate messy business problems into clear, actionable specs \- then stay close to the team until it ships
 *.* 




**What you will do:** 




 ·      Own client discovery end\-to\-end — lead requirement gathering sessions, workshops, and stakeholder interviews independently
 



 ·      Translate business needs into detailed functional specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria the dev team can act on immediately
 



 ·      Be the primary bridge between client and engineering — maintain clarity, flag scope creep, and keep everyone aligned
 



 ·      Drive sprint ceremonies alongside the PM/TL — refinement, planning, demos — and keep the backlog healthy
 



 ·      Proactively identify gaps, risks, and dependencies before they become problems
 



 ·      Use AI tools actively to accelerate research, documentation, and analysis — and help the team adopt them too
 



 ·      Build strong, trusted relationships with client stakeholders at all levels — from ops to leadership
 



**What you bring:** 




 ·      4–7 years as a BA in a software product or services environment — ideally working directly with international clients
 



 ·      Strong technical foundation — you understand APIs, data flows, system integrations, and can read a user story with a dev's eye
 



 ·      Excellent communication — sharp written skills, confident in client meetings, clear under ambiguity
 



 ·      Proven ability to work without hand\-holding — you drive the process, you don't wait to be asked
 



 ·      Comfortable in fast\-moving agile teams — context switches quickly, priorities shift, and that doesn't unsettle you
 



 ·      A natural curiosity — you ask "why" before "what", and you question assumptions others have stopped questioning
 



  





**Must Have:** 




 • Jira / Confluence
 



 • User Story creation and management
 



 • BRD / FRD documentation
 



 • SQL basics
 



 • API concepts
 



 • Agile / Scrum methodology
 



 • Wireframing
 



**Good to Have:** 




 • Figma
 



 • Postman
 



 • Data Modelling
 



 • TestRail
 



 • Miro
 



 • Process Mapping
 



  





**AI fluency — non\-negotiable:** 




 ·      Actively uses AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) in day\-to\-day work — not occasionally, habitually
 



 ·      Can use AI to draft specs, summarize meetings, generate test scenarios, and research domain context faster
 



 ·      Thinks about where AI can reduce friction in the client–dev loop and experiments with it
 



 ·      Stays current — knows what's new, tries things, brings ideas back to the team
 



**What makes you stand out:** 




 ·      You've worked on SaaS products or complex enterprise software — you know what "production\-ready" means
 



 ·      You've managed clients across time zones without losing quality or trust
 



 ·      You've pushed back on a client (diplomatically) and were right — and they respected it
 



 ·      You have opinions about what good requirements look like — and you can defend them
 



  





 Please share your resumes to hr@techgrit.com

title: Consultant - Sales & Service -Amazon Connect
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Customer**
 The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology\-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Level:** 
 Consultant or equivalent
   

  

 As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements .
   

  

**Work you’ll do** 
 :
   

  

* Owns complex deliverables independently, ensuring quality and timelines and Exhibits interest in working across tracks/outside of core skills
* Consistently demonstrates SME skills within their area of expertise and proactively identifies potential risks and come up with mitigation plans \- Performs solution reviews and/or process/code reviews effectively \& independently


**The Team** 
 :
   

  

 Our Sales \& Service team focuses on delivering marketing and growth objectives aligned with our clients’ brand values for measurable business growth. We help clients turn business values into measurable growth through creatively driven, personalized content, communications, and experiences that engage and inspire people to act. We implement and operate the technology platforms that enable personalized content, commerce and marketing user\-centric experiences. In doing so, we transform our clients’ marketing and engagement operations into modern, data\-driven, creatively focused organizations. Our team brings deep experience in creative and digital marketing capabilities by a combination of key focus areas i.e., Brand, Advertising, Experiences, Content, Marketing, Commerce, Products, Data and measurement/analysis.
   

  

**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications**
* 3\-6 years of technology consulting experience, with a focus on cloud operations.
* Minimum of 3\-4 years of hands\-on experience with Amazon Connect and related AWS services.
* Proficiency in designing and implementing Amazon Connect contact flows integrated with Python, Lambda, and JSON.
* Strong working knowledge of AWS services, including but not limited to: AWS Connect, Lex, Polly, Lambda, CloudWatch, Kinesis, Glue, S3, Redshift, SNS, and SQS.
* Solid scripting skills in Python, with the ability to write SQL queries and perform string analysis.
* Familiarity with modern DevOps tools and techniques, including GitHub, CI/CD, and Docker.
* Experience with agile/iterative methodologies for implementing cloud projects.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business and technical requirements into effective technical designs.
* Good understanding of end\-to\-end project delivery methodologies for cloud projects.
* General knowledge of cloud computing technologies and current trends.
* Experience working on CI/CD/DevOps pipelines is a plus.


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Experience working on CI/CD/DevOps pipelines is a plus.


**Education:**
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university


**Location:**
 Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. title: Application Consultant-Edge & Network Cloud
description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Application Consultant specializing in Edge \& Network Cloud, you will utilize your applied knowledge of fundamental concepts and technologies associated with Telecom Network, Software Defined Network/NFV to deliver solutions. You will perform consulting, requirement gathering, and implementation tasks to drive business outcomes. Your primary responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Perform Consulting Services: Deliver expert advice and guidance to clients on the implementation and configuration of ALM, ASM, and various virtual network functions from NEPs.
* Requirement Gathering: Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and create High\-Level Design (HLD) and Low\-Level Design (LLD) documents.
* Implement and Configure Solutions: Apply technical expertise to implement and configure ALM, ASM, and other solutions, ensuring seamless integration with existing OSS systems.
* Integrate with OSS Systems: Work on integrating ALM, ASM, NOI with other OSS systems, depending on the solution scope, to ensure a cohesive and efficient system.
* Solution Delivery: Support the delivery of solutions, leveraging Agile methodologies and lifecycle management best practices.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Telecom Network Fundamentals: Exposure to fundamental concepts and technologies associated with Telecom Network, including Software Defined Network and NFV.
* Consulting and Requirement Gathering: Experience working with stakeholders to gather requirements and create High\-Level Design (HLD) and Low\-Level Design (LLD) documents.
* ALM and ASM Implementation: Exposure to implementing and configuring ALM (Agile life cycle manager) and ASM, with knowledge of integrating these systems with other OSS systems.
* Virtual Network Functions: Familiarity with various virtual network functions from Network Equipment Providers (NEPs) and their implementation in telecom networks.
* OSS System Integration: Experience working with the integration of ALM, ASM, NOI with other OSS systems, depending on the solution scope.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Telecom Network Architecture: Exposure to designing and implementing telecom network architectures, including Software Defined Network and NFV, to support solution delivery.
* Advanced ALM and ASM: Experience with advanced implementation and configuration of ALM and ASM, including integration with other OSS systems.
* Virtual Network Functionality: Familiarity with implementing and configuring various virtual network functions from Network Equipment Providers (NEPs) in telecom networks.

**Title And Summary**
 Software Engineer \- R

* The Economics Institute was launched in 2020 to analyze economic trends through the lens of the consumer to deliver tailored and actionable insights on economic issues for customers, partners and policymakers
* The Institute is composed of a team of economists and data scientists that utilize \& synthesize the anonymized and aggregated data from the Mastercard network together with public data to bring powerful insights to life, in the form of 1:1 presentations, global thought leadership, media participation, and commercial work through the company’s product suites


**About The Role**
 We are looking for an R programmer to join Mastercard’s Economics Institute, reporting to the team lead for Data Systems Engineering. An individual who will:
   

  

* create clear, compelling data visualisations that communicate economic insights to diverse audiences
* develop reusable R functions and packages to support analysis and automation
* create and format analytical content using R Markdown and/or Quarto
* design and build scalable Shiny apps
* develop interactive visualisations using JavaScript charting libraries (e.g. Plotly, Highcharts, D3\.js) or front\-end frameworks (e.g. React, Angular, Vue.js)work with databases and data platforms (eg. SQL, Hadoop)
* write clear, well\-documented code that others can understand and maintain
* collaborate using Git for version control


**All About You**
* proficient in R and the RStudio IDE or Positron IDE
* proficient in R packages like dplyr for data cleaning, transformation, and aggregation
* familiarity with dependency management and documentation in R (e.g. roxygen2\)
* familiar with version control concepts and tools (e.g. Git, GitHub, Bitbucket) for collaborative development
* experience writing SQL and working with relational databases
* creative and passionate about data, coding, and technology
* strong collaborator who can also work independently organized and able to prioritise work across multiple projects comfortable working with engineers, product owners, data scientists, economists


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
**Overview**
 In Microsoft’s CoreAI division, the Azure SRE Agent Platform team builds and runs ‘AI Agents as Service’ that help Microsoft customers detect, diagnose, and mitigate any production issues across customer’s services \& workloads running on Microsoft platforms. Think of these agents as “virtual SRE teammates” that continuously watch your systems, investigate problems, and recommends or performs fixes, with a focus on quality, safety, security, enterprise scale and real\-world impact.
   

  

 Our work spans the full lifecycle of agentic systems in production. We design and improve the core capabilities that shape agent behavior, including tool design, planning and execution loops, orchestration, evaluation, and safety guardrails. We build the operational foundations that make those systems dependable in practice, including observability, progressive delivery, reliability engineering, and live\-site learning. And we build the best user experience for our customers to use these agents from any device seamlessly.
   

  

 We are looking for a full stack Software Engineer II teammate to help build this next generation of agentic systems for cloud operations. This role is for engineers who care deeply about product quality, end\-to\-end ownership, and the details that separate an exciting prototype from a system people trust during critical moments.
   

  

 Engineers on our team operate with high autonomy in a highly agile environment: short cycles, thin slices, feature flags, progressive delivery, and constant learning. We are looking for teammates with strong owner’s mindset and a strong bias for action \- engineers who take ownership of ambiguous problems, adopt modern science research, engineering patterns \& practices, move quickly, learn from production, and continuously raise the quality bar as they ship.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* Build and iterate on agentic systems, including tools, planning and execution loops, evaluations, and safety mechanisms

 Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3\+ years of experience building and operating cloud platforms or distributed services, with depth in service architecture, deployment, and observability
* Strong product mindset with a track record of owning ambiguous problem spaces and driving them to high\-quality outcomes
* Solid engineering fundamentals, including systems design, performance, and debugging in complex production environments

description:
**Manual QA engineer**
 Cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, transforming clients' business, operating, and technology models for the digital era. Our unique industry\-based, consultative approach helps clients envision, build, and run more innovative and efficient businesses. Headquartered in the U.S., Cognizant (a member of the NASDAQ100 and one of Forbes World’s Best Employers 2025\) is consistently listed among the most admired companies in the world.

We combine human expertise with intelligent automation, ML operations, and digital experience solutions to help technology and digital\-native companies build smarter, more adaptive operating models.
   

  

**What is the opportunity?**
 We are looking for a
 **Manual QA Engineer**

You will support the quality of AI and non\-AI agents used in real\-world business processes, from browser automation to system integrations.

**What will you be doing?**

* Perform manual testing of automation agents and end\-to\-end workflows
* Review functional requirements and create clear, structured test cases
* Execute test sessions directly with customers, assisting them during validation
* Provide Level 1 support, identifying issues, answering questions, and escalating appropriately
* Identify, document, and track defects with precise reproduction details
* Support regression testing and validation before go live.
* Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, and product teams
* Contribute to continuous quality improvement across the Delivery practice


**You Will Know You’re Successful If**

* You maintain outstanding standards in documentation, clarity of communication, and defect reporting
* Customers feel supported, well\-guided, and confident during test sessions


**Must Have**

* prior experience as a Manual QA in an Agile environment
* Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test case design, and defect management
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of testing deliverables
* High attention to detail and strong analytical thinking
* Comfortable interacting directly with customers in testing and support contexts


**Nice To Have**
* Experience testing browser\-based workflows
* Familiarity with automation concepts, RPA, or scripting
* Understanding of REST APIs or system integrations
* Interest in AI agents and prompt engineering
* Exposure to continuous testing or CI/CD pipelines


**Why join us?**
* Work on the cutting edge of AI powered automation and intelligent agents
* Tackle challenging quality problems in a high ownership environment
* Join a diverse and internationally distributed team (15\+ nationalities across 10\+ countries)
* Remote\-first setup with optional access to one of our 13 offices in India
* Flexible working hours
* Collaborative, pragmatic engineering culture focused on outcomes
* Be part of a fast\-growing division within Cognizant, with global visibility and strong career growth opportunities.

description:
Job Purpose and Impact
   

  

* The Professional, Software Engineering job maintains and partners to design and develop software applications and systems. With limited supervision, this job collaborates with cross functional teams to implement new software features to meet user needs and business goals and upgrade existing software to improve performance and functionality through writing clean, efficient and scalable code and troubleshooting and debugging moderately complex issues. This job also participates in code reviews to maintain high code quality and share knowledge with software engineering team members.


 Key Accountabilities
   

  

* SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT: Partners to design and develop high quality software solutions by writing clean, maintainable and efficient codes.
* AUTOMATION: Applies internal software deployment platform, methodologies and tools to automate the deployment process, ensuring smooth and reliable releases.
* COLLABORATION: Partners with cross functional team of product managers, designers and other engineers to gather moderately complex requirements and deliver solutions that meet business needs.
* TESTING \& DEBUGGING: Writes and maintains moderately complex unit tests and integration tests, and performs debugging to maintain the quality and performance of the software.
* CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT: Makes suggestions for improving the software development and deployment processes, and implements the approved standards to improve efficiency and reliability.
* DOCUMENTATION: Drafts and maintains comprehensive documentation for moderately complex software applications, deployment processes and system configurations.
* TECHNICAL SUPPORT: Provides technical support and troubleshooting for moderately complex issues with deployed applications to ensure minimal downtime and fast resolution.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum requirement of 2 years of relevant work experience. Typically reflects 3 years or more of relevant experience.

description:
**About Us:**
 YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e\-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.
   

  

 Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high\-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.
   

  

 We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View) APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award\-winning, people\-centric culture—recognized by
 *Inc.* 
 as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.
   

  

**What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:**
 YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact\-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.
   

  

**Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:**
* Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high\-impact projects with real business outcomes
* Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
* Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
* Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


**Who Thrives Here?**
 We hire sprinters, not coasters—people who:
   

  

* Choose growth over comfort
* Lead through challenges
* Are energized by high expectations


 It’s not for everyone, and that’s intentional. If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.
   

  

**This is a fully remote opportunity based in India. Standard work hours are from 8 am to 5 pm IST.**
**About The Role:**
 As a Frontend Engineer, you will join a top\-tier engineering team to develop a brand\-new mobile product aimed at delivering an exceptional user experience and making everyday life easier for our users.
   

  

* Take ownership of new product development from concept to implementation
* Collaborate closely with global teams to understand business requirements and contribute to technical discussions
* Apply creativity and explore new technologies to deliver high\-performance and user\-friendly solutions
* Maintain and enhance existing products through iterative updates and user experience improvements


**You Are Likely To Succeed, If:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
* 4\+ years of experience in front\-end development
* Proficient in TypeScript, JSX, CSS, HTML5, Redux, GraphQL and NodeJS
* Strong hands\-on experience with React for building web applications
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a focus on performance optimization
* Familiarity with module bundlers and performance tuning tools (e.g., Webpack) is a plus


**What We Offer:**
**Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:**
* We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
* Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self\-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high\-impact, high\-opportunity work environment above!
* The final offer may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, as well as internal team benchmarks.

We are looking for an experienced React.js Developer with a minimum of 3\-4 years of experience. You will be responsible for building and optimising the front\-end experience for CashKaro and EarnKaro.

* Designing, developing, and implementing web applications using Next.js and related front\-end technologies, such as React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Frontend Engineer Intern
description:
Experience: 0 to 2 years (final\-year students, fresh grads, or early\-career frontend engineers welcome)
 





 Location: Mumbai only, Corporate Chamber 1085, Hotel Sahara Star, Vile Parle
 





 Salary: Competitive stipend during internship with conversion to full\-time based on performance
 





 Expected Notice Period: Immediate
 





 Shift: GMT\+05:30 Asia/Kolkata IST
 





 Opportunity Type: In\-office Mumbai (mandatory, no hybrid or remote)
 





 Placement Type: Full Time Internship (with strong intent to convert to permanent)
 





 What do you need for this opportunity?
 





 Must have skills required:
 




  






 Figma fluency (reading, building, and iterating on screens, not just viewing)
 





 Translating Figma designs into pixel\-accurate, responsive frontend code
 





 React (hooks, state management, component architecture)
 





 Next.js or equivalent modern frontend framework
 





 HTML, CSS, and Tailwind (or equivalent utility\-first styling)
 





 TypeScript or strong JavaScript fundamentals
 





 REST API integration (auth headers, error handling, loading and empty states)
 





 Working knowledge of how to read backend API contracts and wire them up correctly
 





 Git and version control fluency (clean commits, useful PRs, no broken main)
 





 An obsession with shipping things that work exactly as expected
 




  






 Renate is Looking for:
 





 Frontend Engineer Intern
 





 The Role
 





 As Frontend Engineer Intern at Renate, you build the product end\-to\-end on the frontend. This is not a "convert mocks to code" seat. You will design screens in Figma, build them in code, wire them to live backend APIs, and ship features that real clients use the same week you ship them. You own the screen from idea to production, including making sure every API call, edge case, loading state, and error state actually works. You report directly to the founder.
 





 Your Impact
 




  






 Build and iterate on Figma screens for new features alongside the product and founder
 





 Translate those screens into pixel\-accurate, responsive, production\-ready frontend code
 





 Wire up backend APIs end\-to\-end, including auth, headers, loading states, error states, and empty states
 





 Catch and handle every edge case before the user does, so features behave exactly as expected
 





 Ship features to production through proper Git workflows, with clean commits and reviewable PRs
 





 Collaborate with backend and AI engineers to align on API contracts, data shapes, and timelines
 





 Maintain frontend code quality, performance, and accessibility as the product scales
 





 Feed UX and product signals back to the team so the next iteration is sharper than the last
 




  






 What You Bring
 




  






 Genuine end\-to\-end ability, where you have built and shipped something real that you can demo, not just completed tutorials
 





 Comfort moving fluidly between Figma and code, without needing a designer to hand\-hold the visual side
 





 Working understanding of React, Next.js (or equivalent), and modern frontend tooling
 





 Confidence integrating REST APIs and handling real\-world failure modes
 





 A high\-taste eye for UI quality, spacing, typography, and interaction polish
 





 High ownership, high speed, and comfort with ambiguity
 





 Ability to track your own work and ship without being chased
 





 Mumbai\-based or willing to relocate immediately
 




  






 Nice to Have
 




  






 A portfolio, personal site, or shipped project that demonstrates both design and engineering chops
 





 Exposure to component libraries like shadcn/ui, Radix, or Chakra
 





 Familiarity with animation libraries (Framer Motion) and micro\-interaction design
 





 Experience working with tRPC, GraphQL, or typed API clients
 





 Understanding of recruitment, HR tech, or B2B SaaS UX patterns
 





 Prior internship, freelance, or hackathon work where you shipped to real users
 




  






 About Renate
 



* Renate is an AI recruitment system. Companies and staffing agencies source candidates through their existing channels, and Renate takes over everything after that, screens every applicant, interviews top candidates via live adaptive phone calls in 13 languages, delivers ranked shortlists with structured scorecards, and supports clients through final\-round interviews. The product is live and pilot clients are already onboarded. We are an 8\-person team in Mumbai, shipped v1 in 6 weeks, and are scaling distribution across India and MENA. US competitors have validated this market with $60M\+ in funding but haven't entered the region. We have.

title: Back End Developer
description:
**Back End Developer** 




 RocketPay (Absird Financial Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) \| HSR Layout, Bengaluru (On\-site)
 



  





**About RocketPay** 




 We started in 2022 because the collections layer in India was broken. Lenders found out about defaults too late. Distributors waited months to know if a retailer would pay. Businesses had no compliant way to collect what was owed. Everyone was building at the transaction layer — nobody was going deeper into what happened after credit was given.
 



  





 We decided to build that infrastructure. Today, RocketPay sits between payment initiation and default — preventing losses before they happen, not cleaning them up after. We are not a payment gateway, and we are not a debt recovery platform. We are the pipe through which credit collections and recovery flows.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You'll join our shared backend/platform team, building and maintaining services that power both SuperKey and Mandate. Expect to own features end\-to\-end — from API design to deployment — across payments flows, partner integrations, internal tooling, and reconciliation systems.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Design, build, and maintain backend services in Java / Spring Boot
* Build and integrate APIs with payment partners and device security partners
* Own reliability, observability, and performance of services handling financial transactions
* Write clean, tested, production\-grade code; participate in code reviews
* Debug production issues across the stack; contribute to recon, settlement, and dispute workflows
* Collaborate directly with founders, ops, and product on fast\-turnaround builds



  





**Requirements** 



* 1 year of backend engineering experience
* Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot
* Prior startup experience is preffered — comfort with ambiguity, ownership, and shipping fast
* Solid fundamentals: REST API design, relational databases (MySQL / PostgreSQL), version control (Git)
* Ability to debug production issues and reason about distributed systems
* On\-site availability at our HSR Layout, Bengaluru office



  





**Good to Have** 



* Exposure to payments, UPI, NACH, or fintech APIs
* Experience with AWS / GCP, Docker, CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with Kafka, Redis, or message queues
* Open\-source contributions or side projects



  





**What You'll Get** 



* Direct ownership of systems used by thousands of retailers across India
* Close collaboration with founders and senior engineers
* Fast feedback loops — what you build ships within days, not quarters



  





**To Apply:** 
 Send your resume and GitHub / portfolio to divyam@rocketpay.co.in

title: Human Resources Coordinator
description:
We are looking for HR Coordinators who can act as the face of the organization throughout the candidate journey. At CynLr, we believe alignment begins before a person joins, not after. The first interaction a candidate has with us shapes how they understand the company, the role, and the founder’s intent. In this role, you will do the heavy lifting of translating that intent into clear, thoughtful, and compelling communication across every stage of hiring and onboarding.
 



**About the Role** 




 As an HR Coordinator, your primary contribution will be to shape how candidates experience CynLr from the moment they discover an opportunity to the moment they join. You will support hiring teams in carrying the organization’s impression in an insightful, consistent, and high\-context manner. This role combines recruitment coordination, employer branding, stakeholder communication, process discipline, and early\-stage organizational alignment.
 



**What You Will Do** 




 • Applicant stage: Adapt job descriptions to the requirements and audience of each platform, including LinkedIn, the company website, and other relevant channels, to improve discoverability and attractiveness. Research candidate demographics, skill combinations, and platform behavior to determine where and when to publish roles for maximum relevance.
 



 • Campus recruitment: Support high\-coordination campus hiring efforts where the objective is not volume but identifying the right candidate in a difficult market. Help manage large applicant pools, communication flows, institution coordination, and branding touchpoints across campuses.
 



 • Candidate stage: Send and coordinate emails for tests and interviews, share preparation details, ensure support team availability, maintain test records and reports, and contribute to the design of filtering criteria using available assessment data.
 



 • Selected candidate stage: Manage candidate confirmations, coordinate interview logistics with relevant stakeholders, maintain interview performance records, and ensure timely follow\-up communication for all candidates who participate in the process.
 



 • Onboarding stage: Log new joiner details into internal systems, generate employee IDs, coordinate with IT for asset issuance, collect required documents, and administer internal and statutory induction programs.
 



 • Employer impression and communication: Act as a consistent and professional point of contact for candidates, helping remove communication roadblocks and ensuring that the organization’s values, expectations, and founder’s impression are carried meaningfully throughout the journey.
 



**Job Requirements** 




 • Domain and tool knowledge: Understanding of business operations, communication fundamentals, HR operations, employer branding, and negotiation. Familiarity with major job portals, applicant tracking systems, payroll software, and strong working knowledge of MS Office tools.
 



 • Core skills: Strong organization, documentation, and coordination skills, with the ability to interface effectively with external stakeholders. Excellent professional communication and negotiation skills, an understanding of human psychology, and the ability to manage expectations with maturity and clarity.
 



 • Behavioral tendencies: Critical thinking, responsibility, versatility, resourcefulness, availability, thoroughness, and strong attention to detail.
 



**What Success Looks Like** 




 • Roles are clearly defined, market\-informed, and aligned with the company’s stage and business needs.
 



 • Hiring processes are structured, candidate\-centric, and continuously improving through data and feedback.
 



 • Strong talent pipelines are built across experienced hiring, campus hiring, and institutional partnerships.
 



 • Employer messaging resonates with the right candidates across different talent segments and platforms.
 



 • Cross\-functional hiring teams are supported with clarity, responsiveness, and strategic insight.
 



**Who We Are Looking For** 




 • You are deeply curious and prefer understanding the problem before applying templates or assumptions.
 



 • You are action\-oriented and enjoy building, coordinating, and improving systems rather than only advising on them.
 



 • You think analytically and can connect business context, talent strategy, and market behavior.
 



 • You communicate clearly and can work effectively across founders, hiring managers, HR teams, branding teams, and operations stakeholders.
 



 • You are excited by startup environments where roles evolve quickly and thoughtful hiring can create outsized impact.
 



**Who You Will Work With** 




 You will work closely with the HR and Talent Management team for execution. You will also collaborate extensively with Branding and Tech teams to shape role narratives and hiring journeys, and partner with Operations and Finance teams where planning and budget considerations are involved.
 



**How Your Career Progresses** 




 We see this role as the starting point of a long\-term journey into Human Resources Management at CynLr. In a startup environment, the company evolves quickly and the needs of the organization expand continuously. Over time, this role can open pathways into specialized areas within HR, including talent acquisition, people operations, employer branding, onboarding, and broader organizational development.
 



**Why Join Us** 




 If you are excited by the idea of building hiring systems that are strategic, analytical, and deeply human, this role offers the chance to shape how a company discovers and develops talent from the ground up. You will help define not just who we hire, but how we think about roles, talent markets, candidate journeys, and long\-term organizational growth.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Do you love solving real\-world data problems with the latest and best techniques? And having fun while solving them in a team! Then come join our high\-energy team of passionate data people. Jash Data Sciences is the right place for you.
 



  





 We are a cutting\-edge Data Sciences and Data Engineering startup based in Pune, India.
 



 We believe in continuous learning and evolving together. And we let the data speak! 
 



  





**What will you be doing?** 



* You will be discovering trends in the data sets and developing algorithms to transform raw data for further analytics
* Create Data Pipelines to bring in data from various sources, with different formats, transforming it, and finally loading it to the target database.
* Implement ETL/ ELT processes in the cloud using tools like AirFlow, Glue, Stitch, Cloud Data Fusion, DataFlow.
* Design and implement Data Lake, Data Warehouse, and Data Marts in AWS, GCP, or Azure using Redshift, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, etc.
* Creating efficient SQL queries and understanding query execution plans for tuning queries on engines like PostgreSQL.
* Performance tuning of OLAP/ OLTP databases by creating indices, tables, and views.
* Write Python scripts for orchestration of data pipelines
* Have thoughtful discussions with customers to understand their data engineering requirements. Break complex requirements into smaller tasks for execution.



  





**What do we need from you?** 



* Strong Python coding skills with basic knowledge of algorithms/data structures and their application.
* Strong understanding of Data Engineering concepts including ETL, ELT, Data Lake, Data Warehousing, and Data Pipelines.
* Experience designing and implementing Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, and Data Marts that support terabytes scale data.
* A track record of implementing Data Pipelines on public cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure) is highly desirable
* A clear understanding of Database concepts like indexing, query performance optimization, views, and various types of schemas.
* Hands\-on SQL programming experience with knowledge of windowing functions, subqueries, and various types of joins.
* Experience working with Big Data technologies like PySpark/ Hadoop
* A good team player with an ability to communicate with clarity
* Show us your git repo/ blog!



  





**Qualification** 



* 1\-2 years of experience working on Data Engineering projects for Data Engineer I
* 2\-5 years of experience working on Data Engineering projects for Data Engineer II
* 1\-5 years of Hands\-on Python programming experience
* Bachelors/Master's degree in Computer Science is good to have

description:
**About Tacheon**




  






 Founded in 2017, Tacheon is a growth\-as\-a\-service consulting firm that helps brands with all things growth.
 




  






 Tacheon has four core verticals:
 




  





**1\. Fractional Chief Growth Officer** 




  






 We work with early\-stage and growth\-stage consumer brands as a Fractional Chief Growth Officer and drive all growth initiatives from process optimization to pricing, distribution and promotion strategies. These include product portfolio optimization, building processes and structure to scale, sharpening brand and product communication and efficiently scaling customer acquisition and retention.
 




  





**2\. Digital Transformation \& Growth Strategy Consulting** 




  






 We work with enterprise brands and help them build capability in their growth and marketing teams and solve specific growth challenges.
 




  





**3\. Data Warehousing and Analytics** 




  






 We help businesses reduce their time from data to actionable insight by building a data warehouse with data from all business data sources, along with customized dashboards and alerts.
 




  





**4\. Generative AI Consulting** 




  






 We have been working in the AI space since 2019 when we launched Smacient, a portal to help marketers leverage AI to be more productive and efficient. Today, Smacient has evolved into a solutions provider to help businesses leverage generative AI for business efficiency and growth. While we work on AI implementation at Smacient, we focus on AI consulting and advisory at Tacheon.
 




  





**About Smacient:**




  






 Founded in 2019, Smacient helps businesses automate processes, enhance team productivity and accelerate growth by leveraging AI and automation.
 




  






 Smacient has 3 core solutions:
 




  





**1\. AI Content Hub** 





 A one\-stop hub with content and information to help marketing and growth teams leverage AI to improve their efficiency 
 




  





**2\. AI Products** 





 Products designed to help marketers and grwoth teams work smarter and be more productive
 




  





**3\. AI Automation Services** 





 Building custom AI solutions to help businesses harness the full potential of AI to automate processes, enhance team productivity, and accelerate growth.
 




  





**Why join us?**




  




* Transformative Projects: Engage in transformative data projects that drive decision\-making and strategic planning for various brands.
* Advanced Technologies: Be part of a cutting\-edge team utilizing advanced technologies in a growing consulting environment.
* Large\-scale Data Environments: Expand your expertise in managing large\-scale data environments and crafting impactful data\-driven strategies.
* Business Strategies: Gain comprehensive experience in business growth strategies, invaluable for future entrepreneurial ventures.
* Diverse Exposure: Work on a wide range of projects that span various industries and technical challenges, ensuring no two days are alike.
* Collaborative Culture: Join a team of like\-minded individuals who value teamwork, knowledge sharing, and mutual growth.
* Career Development: Opportunities for personal and professional growth in a company that encourages continuous learning and provides the resources to support your development.
* Impact: Make a real impact in shaping the products and technologies that define our clients’ success and the organization’s future.



  





**Who You'll Work With:**




  






 You will work very closely with the founder Rohit Uttamchandani, who comes with over a decade of very rich experience in the industry. He is the author of the book D2C Growth Blueprint (available on Amazon and Kindle), which helps early\-stage D2C brands scale from zero to 10000 orders a month within a year of starting up. He has set up data warehouses for multiple brands and has helped them go from data to actionable insight in quick time. 
 




  






 He was recognized as one of the 100 Smartest Digital Marketing Leaders 2020 by ET Now, World Marketing Congress, Global Federation of Marketers \& CMO Global and has also been featured in the exchange4media 40 Under 40 list in November 2021\. He will mentor and guide you and help you elevate your career to new heights.
 




  





**About the Role**




  






 We are looking for a driven and curious Data Engineer \& Product Developer to join our marketing technology team. This is a holistic role where you will be expected to think as an engineer, a product developer, and a business stakeholder all at once.
 




  






 If you enjoy figuring things out, moving fast, and taking ownership of what you build from idea through to delivery, this role is for you.
 




  





**What You'll Do**




  





**Data Engineering** 




  






 ▸  Design, build, and maintain data pipelines on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
 




  






 ▸  Work with a variety of APIs to fetch, transform, and load data efficiently \- the specific platforms will vary based on what we are building.
 




  






 ▸  Model and structure marketing data into clean, relational schemas that support analysis and reporting.
 




  






 ▸  Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across pipelines.
 




  





**Product Development** 




  






 ▸  Collaborate in ideating, designing, and shipping tools that help marketing teams work more efficiently these could be AI\-powered or otherwise.
 




  






 ▸  You will need to be comfortable jumping into a new product idea, understanding what it needs to do, and contributing meaningfully whether that is scoping it, prototyping it, or helping refine it.
 




  






 ▸  Build quick prototypes to validate ideas before full\-scale development.
 




  






 ▸  Understand business requirements and translate them into clear technical thinking.
 




  





  





**What We're Looking For**




  





**Must Have** 




  






 ▸  Internship with 0\-1years or 1 year of experience in a data, engineering, or product\-adjacent role
 




  






 ▸  Solid understanding of SQL basics and working with relational databases.
 




  






 ▸  Familiarity with Python for scripting, data processing, or API integrations.
 




  






 ▸  Experience integrating REST APIs to fetch and load data.
 




  






 ▸  Comfortable using Git and GitHub for version control and collaboration.
 




  






 ▸  A systems thinker \- you understand how different pieces connect and affect each other.
 




  






 ▸  Open to using AI tools in your day\-to\-day work and genuinely eager to keep learning.
 




  






  
 




**Good to Have** 




  






 ▸  Hands\-on exposure to Google Cloud Platform \- BigQuery, Cloud Functions, or similar services.
 




  






 ▸  Some exposure to marketing data platforms and analytics tools.
 




  






 ▸  Prior experience with product development cycles \- personal, academic, or professional projects all count.
 




  





**What matters most** 




  






 Demonstrated curiosity, problem\-solving ability, and ownership \- through internships or projects
 




  





**Key Traits We Value** 




  






 ▸  Problem\-solver first: you find ways around blockers rather than waiting for someone to hand you a solution.
 




  






 ▸  Business\-aware: you understand that what you build must serve real user and business needs, not just technical ones.
 




  






 ▸  Full ownership: you see things through from the initial idea to a shipped, working product.
 




  






 ▸  Continuous learner: this space moves fast — we want someone who moves with it.
 




  






 ▸  Team player: you will be working from our Chennai office five days a week, and being present, communicative, and collaborative matters.
 




  






 We don't just want someone who can follow instructions.
 




  






 We want someone who asks "what if we tried this?" — and then goes and tries it.
 




  






 If you’re ready to work in an exciting environment where learning and growth are at the core, we would love to hear from you. Join us and make an impact on both the products we build and the skills you develop!

Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 We are seeking a talented and motivated QA/Test Developer with performance testing expertise to join our dynamic team. The QA/Test Developer will play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of our world class data security solution. You will work closely with the development and quality assurance teams to identify and address performance bottlenecks and ensure a seamless user experience. You need to be versatile, display leadership qualities and open minded to take on new problems that our customers face.
   

  

 IBM Guardium Data Protection is a market leader in the data security domain. This enterprise\-grade product protects sensitive data across hybrid cloud environments, databases, data warehouses, big data platforms, and file systems, serving thousands of customers globally.
   

  

**Essential Job Functions**
**Performance Testing \& Engineering**
* Design, develop, and execute performance, load, stress, and scalability tests for applications (including data security platforms such as Guardium or similar).
* Define and implement performance testing strategies aligned with business and technical requirements.
* Identify performance risks early and proactively suggest mitigation approaches.


**Test Planning \& Strategy**
* Create comprehensive performance test plans, scenarios, and workload models based on system architecture and usage patterns.
* Collaborate with architects and developers to ensure performance considerations are integrated into the design phase.


**Scripting \& Automation**
* Develop, enhance, and maintain performance test scripts using tools such as Apache JMeter, LoadRunner, or equivalent.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipeline integration for automated performance regression testing.


**Monitoring, Analysis \& Optimization**
* Monitor application and infrastructure performance using APM and monitoring tools.
* Analyze test results, identify bottlenecks (CPU, memory, I/O, network, database), and provide actionable insights.
* Work closely with development and DevOps teams to tune application performance.


**Reporting**
* Prepare detailed performance test reports, dashboards, and executive summaries.


**AI\-Driven Testing \& Innovation**
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot or similar) to accelerate scripting, test design, and analysis.
* Explore modern performance engineering practices, including predictive analysis and intelligent test optimization.


**Collaboration \& Documentation**
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including QA, development, DevOps, and product management.
* Maintain thorough documentation of test strategies, scripts, configurations, and results.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Stay current with emerging trends, tools, and best practices in performance testing and engineering.
* Drive improvements in performance testing processes, tools, and frameworks.


**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
**Required Skills and Competencies**
* Proven experience in performance testing, including load testing, stress testing, and scalability testing
* Hands\-on skills on SQL and Database performance analysis tricks and tools
* Hands\-on knowledge of continuous integration and continuous delivery and source code management (preferably GIT)
* Strong proficiency in performance testing tools and scripting languages (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling)

* Good problem\-solving skills and proficiency in Java or Groovy
* Strong scripting skills in at least one language (BASH, Groovy)
* Ability to manage multiple projects, while ensuring that commitments and timelines are met
* Familiarity with AI\-powered development tools and willingness to adopt AI assistants for code generation, test automation, and productivity enhancement


**Good To Have Skills And Competencies**
* Experience with monitoring frameworks (Nagios, Prometheus, DataDog, App dynamics etc)
* Experience with Unix/Linux commands related to system performance including top, iostat, dstat, sar, vmstat
* Experience with performance assessment tooling and technologies such as JMeter, JConsole, perf and be able to develop custom tooling
